title: Principal Technical Marketing Engineer
description:
Bangalore, Karnātaka, India Product Engineering Ref ID: JR-024152

**Our Mission**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

**Who We Are**

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

**Job Summary**

As a Principal Technical Marketing Engineer for Prisma AIRS at Palo Alto Networks, you will join a team responsible for driving AI security. You will work with cutting-edge technology, redefining the future.

This role plays a key role in supporting our product managers, marketing teams, and customers by developing outbound technical communication, including product best practices, competitive reviews, demo environments, and ownership of product betas. You will perform technical analysis and support the product management in identifying next-generation innovations. This is a critical customer facing role within the company and one where the right person can have significant impact.

The ideal candidate would be able to influence strategy, collaborate with marketing and sales teams to execute go to market strategies, act as a thought leader at the industry level, evangelizing the products and product strategy both internally and externally.

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

* Develop, constantly refine, and execute the technical marketing plan
* Utilize AI to scale your impact by creating innovative enablement and defining the art of the possible.
* Present Executive Briefings to C-Suite executives with deep technical expertise.
* Be responsible for the creation, maintenance, and delivery of effective technical tools, whitepapers, demos, videos and technical training for sales, customers, and partners
* Be a key technical evangelist for Palo Alto Networks, speaking at seminars, conferences, customer briefings, and with other groups within the company
* Work with engineering in identifying product gaps based on competitive analysis and work with the PM to drive enhancements to bridge them
* Be the domain authority on Palo Alto Networks products to help Domain Consultants with information on competitive questions
* Identify Sales challenges based on any competitive situations and provide solutions
* Document technical concepts to ensure our products are well understood and utilized to the greatest extent possible
* Work with marketing to develop collaterals with battle cards, presentations, and white papers

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* 7+ years of experience as a Technical Marketing Engineer for network/cybersecurity area or a DevOps/Solution Architect, preferably for AI security, network, or data security products
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong presentation skills and trade show experience
* Eagerness to learn new technologies, experiment with products and collaborate cross-functionally
* Strong customer advocacy skills and experience, ability to work in difficult customer situations
* Work towards getting things done, Fast learner with strong initiative and sense of ownership
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

* Experience in automation tools, building dashboards, etc.
* Experience with writing and editing technical documentation and operational procedures

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

**Role**

Marketing Buyer DGP

**A purpose driven role for you**
---------------------------------

Your responsibilities will include but not limited to:
  
1.Category Purchasing: Drive strategic sourcing, vendor selection, and request for proposal (RFP) processes within the marketing domain.
  
2.Cost Efficiency: Identify target LEAP projects and design alternate product sourcing pipelines to secure year-round cost savings.
  
3.Process Alignment: Implement automated process guidelines, system-generated comparatives, and strict contracting benchmarks.

**A Day in the life**
---------------------

You will be working on day-to-day basis on following:
  
1. Operational Execution: Reviewing daily purchase requests, preparing comparative statements, and issuing formal POs in the system.
  
2. Delivery Tracking: Updating commitment dates and tracking supplier schedules to achieve a >95% delivery ratio for projects.
  
3. Commercial Analysis: Performing detailed costing analysis, scope optimization, and price settlements with category suppliers.
  
4. Vendor Monitoring: Evaluating ongoing vendor performance and managing documentation for annual rate contract agreements.
  
5. Stakeholder Interfacing: Clarifying unclear specifications with Zonal and Area marketing teams while tracking recent market trends.
  
6. Compliance Management: Coordinating with the Legal department to secure timely closures for NDAs, MSAs, and framework contracts.
  
7. Team Integration: Working cohesively within the central team to balance day-to-day project workflows and field demands.

**Academic Qualification & Experience**
---------------------------------------

1.Education: Graduate degree, with an MBA core specialization in Marketing or Events Management preferred.
  
2.Experience: 6 to 10 years of experience in marketing operations, terminology know-how, and market research.
  
3.Portfolio Scale: Operational tracking of an INR 100 Cr annual category expense across 50 to 100 active vendor accounts.

**Technical Skills/Knowledge**
------------------------------

1.Marketing Sourcing Lifecycle: Complete command over marketing terminology, BTL activation frameworks, and media planning streams.
  
2.Sourcing Analytics: Mastery of comparative statement compilation, data tracking toolkits, and supplier quote auditing.
  
3.SAP MM Transactions: High transactional proficiency inside the SAP MM module environment.
  
4.Contractual Governance: Practical understanding of corporate compliance guidelines, SOPs, and legal agreement execution.
  
5.Office Productivity: Advanced capability in MS Excel and MS Office for managing spend reports and baseline tracking data.

**Behavioural Skills**
----------------------

1.Team Cohesion: Highly collaborative mindset to drive daily coordination smoothly alongside other team members.
  
2.Effective Communication: Clear verbal and written interaction skills to bridge internal marketing units and external service providers.
  
3.Process Orientation: Disciplined adherence to established procurement compliance metrics and audit trails.
  
4.Analytical Ability: Strong problem-solving aptitude to evaluate complex proposals and resolve technical ambiguities.
  
5.Result Driven: Tenacity to manage high-volume field plans and deliver target baseline savings within strict schedules.

**What will it be like to work for Hero**
-----------------------------------------

As the **world’s largest** manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last **25 years**, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. You will become a part of India’s proudest legacy, a brand that is celebrated by **130 million Indians** and is now taking over the world with its manufacturing superpower.

If you are someone who dreams big and goes after their dreams with absolute conviction, Hero is your place to be. At Hero, we are building a cutting-edge future of mobility, pushing frontiers of innovation and aiming for the very best. **Choose to be with the best, choose to be your best.**

**About Hero**
--------------

Hero MotoCorp, headquartered in New Delhi, India, is the world's largest manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for 25 consecutive years with ~$5 billion revenue. The Company's global footprint spans 52 countries across Asia, Africa, Europe, Central and Latin America with a customer base of over 130 million. The Company operates eight manufacturing facilities - six in India and one each in Colombia and Bangladesh- along with two Research and Development centres: Centre for Innovation and Technology (CIT) in India and Tech Centre Germany (TCG).
  
Hero MotoCorp is driving the transition to electric mobility through VIDA, powered by Hero.

Strategic alliances with Harley-Davidson and Zero Motorcycles support the design and development of premium and electric motorcycles, respectively. Further demonstrating its commitment to the EV future, the Company has made strategic investments in two- and three-wheeler EV manufacturers, Ather Energy and Euler Motors. Hero MotoCorp is the only Indian two-wheeler manufacturer listed on the prestigious Dow Jones Sustainability Index (D/SI).

Hero MotoCorp's Executive Chairman, Dr. Pawan Munjal, was named to the 2025 TIME100 Climate List of the 100 most influential leaders driving business climate action.

Beyond mobility, Hero MotoCorp is a major global promoter of sports, including golf, football, field hockey, and cricket. Hero MotoSports Team Rally is India's flag bearer in global rally racing.

title: Marketing and Brand Engagement Executive
description:
**Marketing and Brand Engagement Executive**
============================================

#### **Full Time**

#### **BANGALORE**

Job Summary

  
  

We are looking for a dynamic, energetic, and target-driven Marketing Executive to promote our overseas education services and strengthen our presence across schools, colleges, coaching centres, and other educational institutions. This is a field-intensive role, with approximately 70% of the time spent travelling to educational institutions, conducting promotional activities, organising seminars, and building relationships with key stakeholders.

  
  

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and networking skills, be comfortable with extensive travel, and have a passion for interacting with students and educational professionals.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Institutional Outreach & Relationship Management

* Visit schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and educational organisations to promote the company's overseas education services.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with principals, counsellors, placement officers, teachers, and institutional decision-makers.

* Identify and develop new institutional partnerships to expand the company's network.

  
  

* Marketing & Student Engagement
  

  

* Organise and coordinate seminars, career guidance sessions, education fairs, workshops, and promotional events.

* Deliver presentations on overseas education opportunities, study destinations, universities, admission processes, scholarships, and visa pathways.

* Represent the company at educational events and exhibitions.

* Distribute marketing materials and ensure effective brand visibility at partner institutions.

  
  

* Lead Generation
  

  

* Generate quality student leads through institutional visits and promotional activities.

* Collect and maintain accurate student data and enquiry information.

* Ensure timely follow-up of leads by coordinating with the counselling and admissions teams.

* Meet monthly lead generation and institutional visit targets.

  
  

* Business Development
  

  

* Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and student engagement.

* Develop new marketing initiatives to expand the company's reach.

* Gather market intelligence, competitor information, and student preferences.

  
  

* Reporting & Administration
  

  

* Maintain records of daily field visits, institutional meetings, seminars conducted, and leads generated.

* Submit regular activity reports and market feedback to the reporting manager.

* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of marketing campaigns and events.

  
  

* Qualifications
  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Education, Communications, or a related field.

* 1–3 years of experience in field marketing, educational marketing, business development, admissions, or sales.

* Experience in the overseas education industry is preferred but not mandatory.

  
  

* Required Skills
  

  

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

* Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.

* Confidence in speaking to large student groups and institutional representatives.

* Strong organisational and event coordination skills.

* Lead generation and business development skills.

* Good negotiation and persuasion abilities.

* Basic knowledge of overseas education, study abroad programmes, or international admissions is an advantage.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM software is preferred.

  
  

* Key Competencies
  

  

* Self-motivated and target-oriented.

* Professional and confident personality.

* Excellent interpersonal skills.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Strong problem-solving and planning skills.

* Willingness to travel extensively.

  
  

* Working Conditions
  

  

\* Approximately \*\*70% field work\*\* involving regular travel to schools, colleges, coaching centres, and educational institutions.

* 30% office-based work for planning, reporting, coordination, and follow-up.

* Local travel on a daily basis, with occasional outstation travel for education fairs, seminars, and institutional partnerships.

* Flexible working hours during events and admission seasons.

  
  

* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  

  

* Number of institutional visits completed.

* Number of new institutional partnerships established.

* Number of seminars, workshops, and promotional events organised.

* Student enquiries and qualified leads generated.

* Conversion of leads into counselling appointments and admissions.

* Achievement of monthly and quarterly marketing targets.

* Quality of institutional relationships and repeat engagement.

* Timely submission of activity reports and market feedback.

  
  

* Preferred Candidate Profile
  

  

* Passionate about education and student engagement.

* Comfortable travelling extensively and working in the field.

* Energetic, proactive, and results-driven.

* Possesses a valid driving licence and own vehicle (preferred).

* Fluent in English and the local language.

  
  
  

Interested candidates can mail updated resume to vacancies@edwiseinternational.com or can call on **022 40813** **487**

title: Onboarding Specialist
description:
**Onboarding Specialist**

**Department:** Professional Services

**Level: IC –** Mid-Level

**Location:** Remote

**Type:** Full-Time

**Reports To:** Program Manager, Supplier Onboarding

  

**About Cleo**

Cleo is the AI-native supply chain orchestration company built on modern EDI. We help businesses orchestrate EDI, API, MFT, applications, and trading partner ecosystems with the visibility, intelligence, and control needed to keep business-critical supply chain transactions moving — from order to cash, procure to pay, and everywhere in between. Our platform, Cleo Integration Cloud, brings together integration, workflow automation, real-time monitoring, and Agentic AI intelligence so supply chain, operations, and IT teams can launch partners faster, automate transactions across business systems, resolve exceptions before they become disruptions, and gain actionable insight across the end-to-end supply chain. Trusted by 5,000+ customers across manufacturing, retail, logistics, and distribution, Cleo is headquartered in Rockford, Illinois, with offices in Chicago and Bangalore. We are a team united by one mission: to make supply chains smarter. Cleo Never Stops.

  

**The Opportunity**

As a PS Onboarding Specialist, you drive trading partners (suppliers) from first outreach to production-ready EDI connectivity for customer-sponsored onboarding programs. You are the day to-day contact for suppliers, keeping them moving through registration, testing, and go-live. Your work helps the program hit its connect-by and go-live dates.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Supplier outreach:** Execute multi-touch communication campaigns (email and phone) using the program's approved templates and tone, and track responses and escalations.
* **Registration and enablement:** Guide suppliers through testing portal or WebEDI registration, and answer questions about requirements, timelines, and process.
* **Emails, training, and onboarding:** Address inbound emails from suppliers on inquiries on the programs and products. Assist with the training, setup, and onboarding of suppliers to ensure a smooth onboarding for go-live.
* **Pipeline management:** Maintain accurate supplier status in the Supplier Onboarding Command Center and CRM. Flag at-risk suppliers early and report progress against deadlines.
* **Reporting:** Produce weekly status updates on registrations, testing pass rates, and go-live readiness for the Program Manager and customer stakeholders.
* **Escalation calls:** Run escalation calls with the customer on a weekly basis.
* **Collateral collection:** Assist in collecting the collateral needed to create the onboarding page and supplier communications.
* **Process improvement:** Identify recurring supplier roadblocks. Recommend template, FAQ, and workflow updates that reduce touches per supplier.
* **Collaboration:** Work with Project Managers, Solution Architects, Engineers, Support, and Marketing to keep messaging consistent and issues resolved quickly.

  

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* 2+ years in customer onboarding, implementation, account coordination, or supplier/vendor management
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical requirements to non-technical audiences
* Highly organized, with a track record of managing large volumes of concurrent contacts against deadlines
* Proficiency with CRM tools, Excel/spreadsheets, and email-based workflow tracking
* Comfort adjusting tone for different audiences, from supportive to deadline-driven

  

**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of EDI concepts (X12, trading partner setup, acknowledgments) or B2B integration
* Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Slack/Teams, or similar tools
* Experience in a supply chain, retail, food, or manufacturing environment
* Understanding of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or direct procurement, supplier onboarding, and the related business processes

  

**Working Conditions**

Remote with high email and phone volume. Customers are high volume and require extra attention in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Occasional extended hours may be required.

  

**Behavior Competencies**

**Initiative & Innovation-** Ability to be proactive and develop new ideas

**Level 2: Initiative -**Takes initiatives within their area of responsibility to accelerate finding solutions. Detects problems, escalates with proposed solutions.

  

**Leadership & Management -**Ability to work within or lead a team

**Level 1: Team Oriented -**Actively cooperates with team members, shares knowledge proactively, and seeks advice when needed.

  

**Planning & Organization-** Ability to manage tasks and activities

**Level 2: Scheduling-** Determines a course of action by breaking it into smaller steps, planning and resourcing each, and adjusting for potential problems.

  

**Customer Focus-** Ability to manage relationships with customers

**Level 2: Customer Oriented-** Understands the needs of external customers and keeps them in mind when taking actions or making decisions.

  

**Interpersonal Communication-** Ability to communicate effectively with people

**Level 2: Active Listening & Empathy-** Listens to others' points of view through verbal and non-verbal communication. Formulates own views while understanding others'.

  

**Achievement Focus-** Ability to achieve objectives

**Level 2: Persistence-** Meets targets and fulfills agreements even when adverse circumstances prevail. Stays focused and resourceful under pressure.

  

**Solution Finding-** Ability to analyze situations and find accurate solutions

**Level 2: Information Acquisition-** Identifies gaps in available information and provides solutions for fixing them. Takes new information into account and modifies understanding accordingly.

  

**People Focus-** Ability to account for the human factor

**Level 2: Efficiency of Staff-** Manages own stress and avoids impacting team members. Anticipates and manages potential conflicts. Champions diversity through a positive approach.

  

**AI Fluency**

Uses AI to accelerate project delivery — drafting implementation plans, summarizing customer requirements, and generating documentation faster. Can point to specific examples where AI improved turnaround time or output quality on a customer engagement.

Role-specific expectations for PS Onboarding Specialists:

* Uses AI to draft and tailor supplier outreach (email and call scripts) within the program's approved templates and tone, and to summarize long supplier email threads before follow-up.
* Uses AI to speed up weekly status reporting (registrations, testing pass rates, go-live readiness), spot at-risk suppliers earlier, and prepare for customer escalation calls.

title: Growth Manager, Marketplaces
description:
Kerala Ayurveda | Reports to: Head of Analytics | Location: Whitefield, Bangalore (onsite)

*Run the marketplace business of an 80-year-old Ayurveda brand, and build the AI tools that help run it.*

**About the role**

Kerala Ayurveda is one of India's oldest Ayurveda brands, with over 80 years of heritage. We are a listed, full-spectrum Ayurveda company: we make our own products and run clinics, hospitals, wellness resorts and academies across India, the US and Southeast Asia.

Our marketplace business on Amazon India, Amazon US and Flipkart is a growth engine, and you will own it: its revenue and ad efficiency, its ads and planning, and the way that work gets done.

**One role, two halves**

* **OPERATE · 50%:** Run the marketplace day to day: campaigns and bids, search terms, the monthly plan, and the weekly and monthly business reviews.
* **BUILD · 50%:** Make that work faster and sharper. Build and improve the AI workflows, tools and dashboards we run on. Decide when their output can be trusted, and fix them when it cannot.

The tools you will work on include the ads automation tool, the root-cause analysis app, the WBR agent, and the content and image pipelines.

We want both skills in one person. Running ads well is not enough on its own, and neither is building tools without the operating experience to judge them.

**Who you work with**

You report to the Head of Analytics and work side by side with the Chief Business Officer (CBO). You own delivery against the marketplace revenue and ad-efficiency targets; the CBO signs off the targets and the monthly plan. When the plan and the data disagree, you call it early, with numbers.

**What you will run**

* **Own the number.** Marketplace revenue and ad-efficiency delivery on Amazon India, Amazon US and Flipkart, end to end.
* **Run the ads.** Structure Sponsored Products, Brands and Display campaigns by brand, generic and competitor intent. Harvest search terms, manage negatives, and tune bids and budgets against ROAS and revenue goals.
* **Find the next growth.** Under-invested products that convert well, high-intent searches where we do not rank yet, and new categories. Partner with the content and brand teams on the formats and creatives each campaign needs.
* **Set the plan.** Build the monthly plan by product and campaign, forecast revenue and ROAS by scenario, and flag early when targets conflict.
* **Explain what moved.** Build and present the Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews. Run root-cause analysis on revenue movements, act on the drivers, and double down on what works.

**What you will build**

* **Sharpen our AI tools.** Improve the internal AI workflows and tools behind ads operations, reporting and root-cause analysis, including the budget and bid optimiser, the WBR agent and the RCA app.
* **Scale content and creatives.** Build and improve the content and image pipelines the team uses for listings and creatives.
* **Automate the grind.** Automate the recurring work you do by hand. Set the checks that decide when a tool's output gets used, and keep a log of where it got things wrong.
* **Ship it properly.** Name the requester, agree what "done" means, and document it so others can run it without you.

**What you bring on day one**

* **Experience:** 4+ years in e-commerce, marketplace or performance marketing, with at least 3 years owning revenue or ad targets and budgets on Amazon India, Amazon US or Flipkart. Agency work counts if you held the account target and can show the result.
* **Ad funnel fluency:** CTR, CPC, CVR, ROAS and TACoS, and at least one target you have owned, with where it started and where you took it.
* **SQL:** a good understanding of SQL, and you can write and debug queries on your own, from joins and CTEs to window functions.
* **A builder's track record:** a process, report or tool you have improved at least once, with the before and after. A script, a formula chain or an AI workflow all count.
* **Judgement with data and AI:** a method for checking any tool's output before you act on it, and a data trap you have caught and how you handled it.

**Your first 90 days**

* **Weeks 1–2:** Learn our ads automation tool and its budget and bid optimiser. Review a past week's logs in read-only mode and name one rule you would change.
* **Weeks 1–4:** Get to know our marketplace traffic and search data, known traps included.
* **Weeks 3–6:** Run our Amazon India root-cause workflow and the Flipkart root-cause app on real revenue movements. The Amazon US diagnostic is a build target within these 90 days.
* **Weeks 5–8:** Run the monthly ASIN-level plan cycle with the CBO.
* **Weeks 7–12:** Take on the WBR agent, and one internal workflow you own end to end.

**By day 90,** you own the monthly plan cycle and the WBR, and you have shipped at least one change to an internal AI workflow, with a written note on its failure modes.

**Good to have**

* Flipkart Ads or Amazon US experience
* Python
* Helium 10 and Amazon Brand Analytics
* D2C, FMCG, beauty or wellness background
* Presenting business reviews to a CBO or leadership team

None of these will screen you out.

**Strong ads operator? Apply.**

If you have run Amazon Ads well, we want to hear from you. Our tools are learnable; what we screen for is the habit of making work better. Use AI to move faster, check what it gives you before you act, and show us how you do it.

**How to apply**

1. **Apply:** send your CV and answers to the three questions below (about 700 words in total).

2. **Shortlist:** we review applications and shortlist candidates.

3. **Assignment:** a practical screening exercise on marketplace data. AI tools are allowed; include a one-page method note on what you used and how you checked it. Take the time you need; we weigh reasoning over polish.

4. **Interview:** walk the Head of Analytics and the CBO through your assignment and one workflow from your application.

You will hear from us within 2 to 4 weeks of applying.

**Application questions**

1. Describe one workflow, report or tool you improved in marketplace ads or reporting. If AI was part of it, say how. What was wrong before, what did you change, how did you check the change worked, and where does the new version still get things wrong? (up to 250 words)

2. Share one marketplace result you owned: the target, your starting ROAS, TACoS and revenue, what you changed, and the result. Then describe one number you reported that was wrong, or nearly was. How did you find out, and what did you change afterwards? (up to 250 words)

title: SC KYC Analyst
description:
**About us**

  

For well over a century, ExxonMobil has been at the heart of creating and growing a modern world. We embrace the power and promise of technology, pushing the boundaries of what's possible. For billions around the world, lives are better and last longer because of the innovative problem solving and reliable energy we provide. We don't stop at "good enough." We are committed to doing what's right, even if it's difficult or unpopular. We hold ourselves to high standards, challenge what's possible and invest in innovation to meet society's critical needs.

Real change begins with bold questions, drive, and ambition. Here, your talent, determination and contributions shape how far you'll go and the impact you'll make along the way.

Our future success depends on exceptional people. We invest in developing talent through meaningful work, challenging assignments, mentorship, and experiences that help build the next generation of leaders.

  

**Our Culture**

We are uniquely ExxonMobil. Integrity, care, excellence, resilience and courage, these core values determine how we work every day. At ExxonMobil, our values aren't just words— they're how we show up, focused on delivering the right answer, the right way, every day.

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
------------------------------------

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market-development activities.

  

The Global Business Center - Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role will you play in our team**
---------------------------------------

Conducting risk-based due diligence on prospective and existing counterparties. The role evaluates counterparty identity, ownership and control, business activities, regulatory status, geographic exposure, reputation, sanctions exposure, and other financial-crime or integrity risks.

Manage due diligence cases from initiation through completion, document findings and risk conclusions, identify information gaps and red flags, and escalate material concerns in accordance with company policies and applicable legal and regulatory requirements. The position will work closely with business stakeholders, Law, Risk & Controls, Procurement, Operations, and other control functions to support informed and timely counterparty decisions.

This role requires strong investigative judgment, attention to detail, concise writing, and the ability to balance risk management with business needs.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Conduct initial, periodic, and event-driven due diligence reviews of counterparties, including legal entities, financial institutions, vendors, intermediaries, agents, and other third parties.
* Collect, verify, and analyze corporate registration records, organizational documents, ownership information, licenses, regulatory records, tax forms, certifications, and other supporting documentation.
* Identify and document ultimate beneficial owners, controlling persons, directors, authorized signatories, and relevant affiliates.
* Analyze complex ownership and control structures, including multi-tiered entities, investment funds, trusts, partnerships, state-owned entities, and offshore structures.
* Perform sanctions, PEP, watchlist, enforcement, and adverse-media screening on counterparties and relevant associated persons.
* Conduct open-source and database research to understand the counterparty’s business model, operating history, reputation, geographic footprint, products and services, and expected relationship with the company.
* Evaluate risk factors such as jurisdiction, industry, ownership, government affiliation, sanctions nexus, regulatory history, adverse information, and the nature and purpose of the relationship.
* Assign or recommend counterparty risk ratings using established policies, procedures, and risk-rating methodologies.
* Conduct enhanced due diligence when higher-risk indicators are present, including deeper investigation of ownership, source of funds or wealth when applicable, business rationale, regulatory standing, and adverse information.
* Prepare clear, concise, and well-supported due diligence reports that summarize findings, identified risks, mitigating factors, unresolved questions, and recommended disposition.
* Identify inconsistencies, information gaps, policy exceptions, and red flags, and escalate material concerns to the appropriate Compliance, Legal, sanctions, or risk authority.
* Partner with business sponsors and relationship owners to obtain required information and resolve outstanding due diligence items.
* Maintain accurate and complete case records, supporting evidence, approvals, and audit trails in applicable workflow or case-management systems.
* Monitor review deadlines, case aging, service-level expectations, and periodic-review schedules.
* Support quality-control reviews, internal audits, regulatory examinations, management reporting, and remediation initiatives.
* Stay informed of relevant changes in sanctions, AML, anti-bribery and corruption, beneficial-ownership, and third-party-risk requirements.
  

**Internal interface**

* Law
* Risk Advisory
* Procurement
* Treasurers
* Trading
* Operations
* Supply Planning & Logistics
  

**External interface**

All 3rd party types

**Behavioral Skills**
---------------------

**Analytical judgment**

* Evaluates information in context rather than relying solely on checklist completion.
* Distinguishes relevant risk indicators from immaterial or false-positive information.
* Reaches defensible conclusions when information is incomplete or ambiguous.
* Recognizes when enhanced due diligence or escalation is warranted.
* Current postings repeatedly emphasize risk identification, credible challenge, ethical judgment, investigative ability, and escalation of higher-risk findings.

**Investigative curiosity**

* Asks effective follow-up questions.
* Traces ownership, affiliations, and adverse information across multiple sources.
* Identifies inconsistencies among documents, databases, and counterparty representations.
* Open-source research, ownership analysis, sanctions and adverse-media investigation, and documentation of findings are common features of both analyst and senior analyst roles.

**Attention to detail**

* Produces complete, accurate, and internally consistent due diligence files.
* Applies procedures and documentation standards reliably.
* Maintains a clear audit trail.
* Accuracy, completeness, quality review, file maintenance, and adherence to internal standards are prominent requirements in KYC operations and quality-control postings.

**Written and verbal communication**

* Converts complex facts into concise, decision-ready summaries.
* Clearly explains risks, mitigating factors, and recommendations.
* Communicates professionally with business stakeholders and control functions.
* Narrative drafting, risk memoranda, reporting, and cross-functional coordination feature prominently in comparable roles.

**Stakeholder management**

* Works constructively with business teams while maintaining independence and appropriate challenge.
* Follows up persistently on missing information and approaching deadlines.
* Handles sensitive or potentially contentious issues professionally.
* Comparable postings expect analysts to collaborate with relationship managers, clients, customer service, Compliance, and other stakeholders to obtain documentation and move cases through approval.

**Organization and execution**

* Manages multiple cases and deadlines in a high-volume environment.
* Prioritizes higher-risk matters and time-sensitive escalations.
* Meets service-level and quality expectations with limited supervision.
* Current roles commonly require independent work, workflow tracking, periodic-review management, and timely completion of expiring records.

**Integrity and risk mindset**

* Demonstrates sound ethical judgment.
* Protects confidential information.
* Escalates concerns transparently.
* Applies policies consistently, even when business pressure exists.

**About You**
-------------

**Skills and Qualifications**

  

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, economics, criminal justice, international affairs, legal studies, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Two or more years of experience in KYC, AML, sanctions, compliance, counterparty risk, third-party due diligence, client onboarding, fraud investigation, or a related risk function.
* Working knowledge of risk-based due diligence concepts, including legal-entity verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions, PEPs, adverse media, and enhanced due diligence.
* Experience conducting research using public records, corporate registries, regulatory websites, commercial databases, and other open-source materials.
* Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong business writing skills and the ability to produce concise, defensible risk narratives.
* Ability to interpret policies and apply them to varied legal entities and fact patterns.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, deadlines, and stakeholder requests.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.

**Preferred**

* Experience reviewing corporate entities, financial institutions, investment funds, intermediaries, government-connected entities, or multinational counterparties.
* Experience analyzing complex ownership structures and identifying ultimate beneficial owners.
* Familiarity with OFAC and other major sanctions regimes, PEP screening, adverse-media research, and financial-crime red flags.
* Knowledge of AML, anti-bribery and corruption, export controls, fraud, reputational risk, or third-party-risk frameworks.
* Experience with commercial screening and research platforms such as LexisNexis, Dow Jones, LSEG World-Check, Moody’s Grid, Sayari, Bureau van Dijk Orbis, or similar tools.
* Experience with KYC workflow, case-management, procurement, or governance-risk-and-compliance systems.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory examinations, quality assurance, or remediation projects.
* ACAMS, Certified KYC Associate, Certified Global Sanctions Specialist, Certified Fraud Examiner, or comparable certification.
* Foreign-language proficiency or international research experience where relevant to the counterparty population.

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:

  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
* Retirement benefits
* Global networking & cross-functional opportunities

Please note benefits may change from time to time without notice, subject to applicable laws. The benefits programs are based on the Company’s eligibility guidelines.

description:

Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Job Description:  
The Expense Team Manager in Bangalore will help build, support and oversee key functions across the local Bangalore BXCI Expense Team, with responsibility for overseeing the team on performance of multiple day-to-day expense operations, developing team members, and driving process improvements across travel & entertainment (T&E) and invoice allocation workflows. This role requires a candidate who is highly motivated, detail-oriented, and able to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment supporting a wide variety of functions.  
A strong background in Finance, Accounting, and expense operations is required. The successful candidate will bring significant experience in T&E and invoice allocation processes, expense policy adherence, expense reporting/status updates, and hands-on expertise with expense systems and workflow approvals. It is essential that the team member has managerial presence and can apply sound judgement to help improve operational efficiencies for the global team. We are looking for a collaborative and forthcoming individual who is able to identify risk and guide the team using both sound judgement and technical skills. The individual must be exceedingly capable of managing a very heavy workload, identifying priorities and working along with as well as delegating to team members.  
In addition to oversight responsibilities, the manager will ensure the India COE team develops strong proficiency in BXCI expense coding structures, invoice coding requirements, cost center allocations, and entity-specific expense classifications. The role will oversee accurate coding of invoices and expense allocations across complex BXCI structures while maintaining consistency with firm policies and financial reporting standards.  
Key Responsibilities:  
Core Expense Operations & Oversight  

* Lead the day-to-day management of T&E expense allocations and invoice allocation

processes assigned to the Inda team, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with  
allocation procedures and firm policies.  

* Oversee accurate invoice coding across BXCI expense codes, cost centers, entities, and

allocation structures, ensuring the team understands and applies the firm’s coding  
framework.  

* Review and resolve complex or unclear invoice coding scenarios and provide guidance to the

team on appropriate expense classification.  

* Contribute to expense status reporting, including tracking approvals, aging, bottlenecks, and

resolution plans.  

* Field questions regarding invoice status and provide technical guidance for related

workflows.  
People Leadership & Stakeholder Management  

* Manage, mentor, and develop junior team members; set priorities, provide coaching, and

ensure coverage for critical processes.  

* Serve as a key point of contact for employee questions related to allocations, approvals, and

expense process expectations.  

* Train new India employees on expense management processes. Train team members on

BXCI expense codes, invoice coding standards, allocation procedures, and system  
workflows to ensure consistent application across the team.  
Systems Ownership (EAS + Concur) & Process Improvement  

* Provide system administration support for Expense Allocation System (EAS) and operations

(queue oversight, data maintenance, user support, and issue escalation) especially during  
hours when the New York team is not available.  

* Assist with technical system troubleshooting and user assistance.
* Support special projects to improve controls, reduce cycle times, and improve user

experience. Identify opportunities to simplify invoice coding workflows, improve allocation  
accuracy, and enhance expense processing efficiency across the COE.  
Allocation Governance & Service Management  

* Support allocation of select research, technology, and other services and ensure proper

allocation and documentation.  

* Identify, assess, and escalate operational risks; recommend improvements and implement

solutions with appropriate stakeholders.  

* Monitor coding consistency across invoices and expenses to ensure alignment with BXCI

allocation standards and internal financial controls.  
Qualifications:  
The ideal candidate will possess:  

5+ years of relevant experience in Finance, Accounting, expense operations, invoice allocation, T&E allocation, or related functions (asset management or financial services experience strongly preferred).  

2+ years of people/team leadership experience including prioritization and training.  

Required systems experience: hands-on experience with expense management systems such as Concur and EAS, including workflow approvals, reporting, and troubleshooting/user support.  

Experience reviewing or managing invoice coding across complex expense structures, cost centers, and entities.  

Demonstrated capability to review and enforce policy and allocation procedures, resolve exceptions, and follow up for approvals.  

Strong technical and analytical skills; highly detail-oriented with a strong control mindset.  

Proven capability to manage multiple tasks, shift priorities quickly, and support a wide variety of functions in a dynamic environment.  

Advanced Excel proficiency (e.g., pivots, lookups, reconciliation support).  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the capability to summarize issues, develop recommendations, and make sound decisions.

title: MANAGER/SENIOR MANAGER – ENGINEERING
description:
**MANAGER/SENIOR MANAGER – ENGINEERING**

**Department:** Engineering

**Reports to:** Director - Admin Operations

**Location:** Bangalore

**About the Company:** Perfect Day is on a mission to create a kinder, greener tomorrow using precision fermentation. Leveraging expertise across biology, food innovation, and consumer products, Perfect Day empowers companies to develop, scale, and commercialize next-generation products that satisfy market demands and champion a path towards a more sustainable future.

**About the Department:** The Engineering Department supports site operations by maintaining the reliability, availability, safety, and efficiency of facility infrastructure, laboratory equipment, and utility systems. The team manages engineering projects, equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, and maintenance while ensuring compliance with applicable GLP, EHS, regulatory, and quality requirements.

**Corporate Services:** The Corporate Services Business Unit serves as the foundational infrastructure that enables the other three business units to drive Perfect Day's growth. These functions include Marketing, Communications, Finance, Legal, People & Culture, IT, Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), Facilities, Lab Services, Capital and Strategic Projects.

**Position Summary:** The Manager/Senior Manager – Engineering is responsible for the effective management of engineering operations, including laboratory equipment, utilities, and facility infrastructure. The role leads maintenance and reliability activities, supports engineering projects and equipment lifecycle management, and ensures compliance with applicable GLP, EHS, and regulatory requirements. Working closely with R&D and cross-functional teams, the position enables safe, reliable, and efficient operations through sound engineering practices and continuous improvement.

**What You Will Do:**

· Develop and implement engineering and maintenance strategies, procedures, and plans to improve equipment reliability and operational performance.

· Oversee the operation and maintenance of laboratory equipment, including fermenters, bioreactors, autoclaves, biosafety cabinets, incubators, laboratory centrifuges, purification systems, cold rooms, and deep freezers.

·Oversee the operation and maintenance of utility systems, including HVAC Systems, chillers, Air compressors, Boiler.

· Oversee the operation and maintenance of CETP and RO plant.

* Maintaining compliance documents and submitting monthly/quarterly/annual forms to PCB/CEIG (As applicable)
* Managing HT & LT Power Distribution Panels.
* Overseeing operations and maintenance of UPS and DG

·Prepare, review, and monitor preventive maintenance schedules for laboratory instruments, utility systems, and facility equipment; ensure timely completion of routine checks and maintenance activities.

·Lead troubleshooting and breakdown resolution, coordinate with original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and service providers, and address recurring equipment issues to minimize downtime.

·Coordinate equipment installation, commissioning, calibration, and qualification activities, including preparation and review of relevant documentation (URS, FAT, SAT, DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ).

·Ensure timely documentation and closure of deviations, change controls, risk assessments, and CAPAs; coordinate engineering responses to internal and external audit observations.

· Manage external vendors and service providers for preventive maintenance, calibration, repairs, and other engineering services; coordinate effectively with R&D and other departments to support site operations.

· Promote safe working practices, environmental compliance, sustainability, and good housekeeping across engineering and facility operations.

· Identify and implement opportunities for equipment reliability improvement, resource optimization, and operational efficiency.

title: 4825-Head of Marketing, Revenue Cycle
description:
**Go to Market at Innovaccer**

Our GTM team is passionate about healthcare and wants to leave a positive impact in the ecosystem. We are the tip of the spear that leads the organization externally. We care deeply about our customers and want to resolve their challenges with our solutions. If this excites you, let's chat about how you can help us tell our special story.

**About the Role**

We at Innovaccer are looking for a Head of Marketing, Revenue Cycle to own marketing for our provider-facing revenue cycle portfolio — Flow (Agentic RCM Platform for Healthcare), spanning prior authorization, referral management, coding and CDI, claim submission, denial management, underpayment recovery, payment posting, credentialing, and payer enrollment — end to end, the way a General Manager owns a business: strategy, story, pipeline, and reputation, not just a set of campaigns. Strategy, flight plan, execution, and messaging all sit with one person in this role — a combination that is rare at this level. (**US revenue cycle marketing experience is a MUST** )

Most marketing leadership roles own execution against someone else's plan, or own messaging without the mandate to act on it. This role owns the whole revenue cycle arc, from go-to-market strategy through to how Innovaccer is positioned with provider CFOs, revenue cycle leaders, and operations buyers in the US.

You are not the person running campaigns day to day — you set the plan and the standard, and a team you build and lead executes to it.

Based in India, you will work closely with US-based Product, Sales, and executive leadership, with regular travel to the US for customer meetings, industry events, and leadership offsites.

**A Day in the Life**

* Set the revenue cycle go-to-market strategy for Flow across the US provider market: target segments (provider groups and practices as the initial motion, health systems as the next expansion), competitive positioning against Waystar, R1, Epic Penny/EMPA, Cohere, and the point-solution landscape, and priority use cases, informed by Product roadmap, Sales signal, and provider market research.
* Define the annual and quarterly flight plan for the revenue cycle portfolio and own the marketing budget behind it, deciding what the portfolio will and will not pursue.
* Ensure a continuous flow of provider-specific research grounds the strategy — CFO and revenue cycle leader interviews, win/loss analysis, payer-provider dynamics, denial and underpayment trends, policy and reimbursement shifts, competitive scans — and convert that research into decisions, not decks.
* Own the pipeline generation number for the revenue cycle portfolio directly. Identify the portfolio's Big Bets — the largest, most strategic provider deals, including anchor health systems and large provider groups — and build a dedicated plan around each: account-based engagement, executive touchpoints, and reference activation.
* Own revenue cycle messaging and positioning directly, backed by real RCM domain fluency (prior auth and utilization dynamics on the provider side, coding and CDI, denials and appeals, underpayment and payment variance, patient access and front-end revenue cycle, credentialing and payer enrollment, athenahealth and Epic operating environments) — you write and set the narrative yourself.
* Serve as the primary marketing partner to the Flow Product leader and Sales leadership — sit in Product's planning cadence, own Flow product launches end-to-end from a marketing standpoint, and equip Sales with what they need to win provider deals.
* Coordinate with Gravity's, Atlas's, and Galaxy's Heads of Marketing on revenue cycle–adjacent messaging — Flow's prior auth, coding, and denials work touches payers operationally even though it stays under this role, and the provider interoperability and data foundation story sits with Gravity.
* Represent the revenue cycle portfolio externally — HFMA, Becker's HIT and RCM, HIMSS, provider CFO forums, analyst briefings (KLAS, Gartner), media, and LinkedIn — building a reputation as a revenue cycle market voice, not only an internal operator.
* Lead the revenue cycle portfolio's swimlane owners and the associates running flight-plan execution. Delegate the operational engine with clear ownership, set goals aligned to the flight plan, and grow the team under you. p

**What You Need**

This role is open to candidates from one of two backgrounds. Both paths are equally valid; we are optimizing for the mind and the mandate, not the resume shape.

* **Path A — Deep US revenue cycle marketing experience:**
* + 10+ years of experience in category or product marketing, with direct experience marketing to US providers — health systems, provider groups, physician practices, and ambulatory networks — not payer-only or life sciences healthcare technology experience.
  + Strong understanding of provider revenue cycle operations and economics: prior authorization and referral management, coding and clinical documentation integrity, claim submission and denial management, underpayment recovery, payment posting, credentialing and payer enrollment, and the policy and reimbursement trends shaping provider technology decisions.
  + Direct experience writing and owning revenue cycle messaging and positioning yourself, with the RCM domain fluency to make an independent, defensible call on it — including the ability to position a combined AI-plus-services offering against both software-only incumbents and traditional outsourced RCM.

* **Path B — Top-tier Indian MBA with post-MBA consulting experience:**
* + MBA from a top Indian business school (ISB, IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, IIM Calcutta, or equivalent).
  + 8+ years of post-MBA experience at a top-tier management consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or equivalent), with meaningful exposure to healthcare, provider operations, or revenue cycle engagements — ideally including engagements for US health systems, provider groups, or healthcare technology clients.
  + Demonstrated general management instinct: the ability to walk into an unfamiliar P&L, build a point of view on where the business should go, and get an organization to move behind it. This role is a GM mandate wearing a marketing title, and we expect the consulting path to translate into that.
  + A willingness and ability to build RCM domain fluency fast — ramping to a level where you can write and defend provider-facing messaging yourself within the first six months.
* **Common to both paths:**
* + proven track record of setting strategy and being accountable for the outcome it produces — pipeline and revenue for Path A, client business outcomes or P&L results for Path B — not just executing a plan set by someone else.
  + Experience as a primary partner to senior Product, Sales, or client leadership — sitting in planning cadences and roadmap or strategy conversations, not being briefed after decisions are made.
  + Demonstrated ability to build and lead a team, delegate operational execution, and be judged on outcomes rather than personal output.
  + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to represent the revenue cycle portfolio externally to provider-market analysts, media, and industry audiences at venues like HFMA, Becker's, and HIMSS.
  + Willingness to travel to the US regularly for customer meetings, industry events, and leadership offsites, and to operate across US time zones as the role requires.
  + Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**Here's What We Offer**

* **Generous Leaves:** Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* **Parental Leave**: Leverage one of industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* **Sabbatical**: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* **Health Insurance:** We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
* **Care Program:** Whether it’s a celebration or a time of need, we’ve got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
* **Financial Assistance**: Life happens, and when it does, we’re here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.

Innovaccer is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

**Disclaimer**:

Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

**About Innovaccer**

Innovaccer activates the flow of healthcare data, empowering providers, payers, and government organizations to deliver intelligent and connected experiences that advance health outcomes. The Healthcare Intelligence Cloud equips every stakeholder in the patient journey to turn fragmented data into proactive, coordinated actions that elevate the quality of care and drive operational performance. Leading healthcare organizations like CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health trust Innovaccer to integrate a system of intelligence into their existing infrastructure, extending the human touch in healthcare. For more information, visit www.innovaccer.com.

Check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Instagram, and the Web.

=============================================

**Job Type:** Full-time, Permanent

**About Us**
------------

Blufig is a full-service B2B marketing agency helping technology and enterprise brands achieve their digital growth goals. Having worked with 130+ brands, we aim to transform the B2B agency landscape through innovative, data-driven, and AI-powered marketing solutions.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

You will manage end-to-end content and copy delivery across multiple client accounts, creating everything from SEO blogs and website content to landing pages, ad copy, email campaigns, social media content, case studies, and marketing collaterals.

You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, managing client feedback, maintaining quality standards, and using AI tools to improve research, ideation, writing, and editing workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Content Writing & Copywriting**

* Create high-quality content and compelling copy for websites, landing pages, blogs, SEO articles, LinkedIn, social media, email campaigns, advertisements, case studies, video scripts, presentations, and marketing collaterals.
* Write persuasive, audience-focused copy that supports brand awareness, lead generation, engagement, and conversions.
* Translate complex B2B technology products and services into clear, engaging, and benefit-driven messaging for business decision-makers.
* Develop content aligned with client objectives, target audiences, brand positioning, tone of voice, and marketing goals.
* Adapt writing styles across formats, industries, channels, and stages of the B2B buyer journey.

### **2. Content Strategy & Planning**

* Understand content briefs, campaign objectives, audience personas, and business goals before developing content.
* Contribute to content strategies, editorial calendars, campaign concepts, messaging frameworks, and content distribution plans.
* Identify relevant topics, content angles, audience pain points, and storytelling opportunities.
* Align content with SEO fundamentals, search intent, and relevant keywords wherever required.

### **3. AI-Assisted Writing & Optimization**

* Use AI writing tools and LLMs to support research, brainstorming, content outlines, first drafts, headline variations, and content repurposing.
* Create effective prompts to generate relevant, context-rich, and usable outputs.
* Review, edit, and humanize AI-assisted content to ensure originality, accuracy, clarity, brand consistency, and a natural writing style.
* Identify and eliminate generic, repetitive, vague, or AI-sounding language.
* Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that improve efficiency without compromising creativity or content quality.

### **4. Editing, Quality Control & Delivery**

* Edit and proofread content for grammar, clarity, structure, tone, factual accuracy, and consistency.
* Conduct quality checks to ensure deliverables meet client requirements and brand guidelines.
* Manage revisions, stakeholder feedback, and approval cycles while maintaining high editorial standards.
* Ensure timely delivery of multiple content assignments across client accounts.
* Develop and follow content processes that improve quality, consistency, and workflow efficiency.

### **5. Collaboration & Client Coordination**

* Work closely with content strategists, designers, digital marketers, SEO specialists, web developers, and account managers.
* Coordinate with clients on content briefs, feedback, revisions, and approvals for assigned accounts, where required.
* Incorporate feedback constructively and maintain clear communication throughout the content delivery process.

### **Requirements**

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* **2–8 years of relevant experience** in content writing, copywriting, or a combination of both.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in both long-form content and short-form, conversion-focused copywriting.
* A strong portfolio showcasing blogs, website content, landing pages, social media posts, email campaigns, ad copy, case studies, or other marketing assets.
* Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, storytelling, and communication skills.
* Ability to simplify technical or complex concepts into clear, compelling, audience-focused messaging.
* Understanding of content strategy, audience intent, brand positioning, and marketing objectives.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Comfort working with feedback, ambiguity, and changing priorities in an agency environment.
* Practical experience using AI writing tools and LLMs for research, ideation, drafting, editing, and content optimization.
* Strong editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted content is accurate, specific, engaging, and aligned with brand voice.

**B2B technology, SaaS, enterprise, or digital marketing agency experience will be an advantage.**

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Knowledge of SEO fundamentals, keyword research, on-page optimization, and search intent.
* Familiarity with CMS platforms such as WordPress or HubSpot.
* Understanding of email marketing tools and campaign content.
* Exposure to ABM (Account-Based Marketing) and B2B demand-generation campaigns.
* Understanding of the B2B sales funnel and how content supports awareness, consideration, and conversion.
* Experience maintaining brand voice guidelines across multiple clients.

### **Benefits**

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Health insurance for you and your family.
* Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.
* Exposure to diverse B2B technology brands and marketing challenges.
* A fast-paced, collaborative environment that encourages learning and innovation.
* The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on client growth through content and copywriting.

title: Distributor Account Manager
description:
**Distributor Account Manager – Digital Industries, India**

**Location:** Pune, Delhi, Bangalore (and other primary industrial hubs)

**Purpose:**

Define and drive the regional Distribution Channel Strategy for Siemens Digital Industries (DI). Achieve aggressive sales growth, expand market share, and hit regional revenue targets by cultivating high-performing, profitable, and strategic industrial distribution partnerships. As the primary commercial relationship owner, the Distributor Account Manager is responsible for driving both primary sales (Sell-in: Siemens to Distributor) and secondary sales (Sell-through / POS: Distributor to local machine builders/OEMs, panel builders, System Integrators, contractors, and industrial MRO accounts). The role orchestrates channel expansion into emerging industrial clusters, maintains strict commercial and inventory discipline (stock turns, DOH, buffer stock), mitigates channel conflicts, and leads distributor sales and technical enablement. By aligning partner competencies with Siemens' industry-leading automation, PLC, and drive technologies and digitalization solutions, the Distributor Account Manager strengthens local market reach, elevates brand shelf-space, and ensures consistent, scalable business growth across the assigned territory.

**Main Responsibilities:**

**1. Distribution Channel Strategy, Network Planning & Partner Governance**

* **Formulate & Execute Distribution Strategy:** Develop and implement comprehensive annual regional distribution business plans (ABP) tightly aligned with the Digital Industries portfolio

* **Distributor Network Mapping & White-Spot Expansion:** Continually assess regional industrial coverage; map industrial clusters to identify geographic and vertical white spots; recruit, onboard, and develop specialized automation and drive distributors to maximize local market penetration.

* **Commercial Governance & Agreement Structuring:** Establish and govern annual distributor commercial agreements, credit terms, tiered discount structures, Special Price Agreements (SPAs), and performance-linked quarterly/annual growth rebates to drive profitable volume growth.

* **Channel Mindshare & Shelf-Space Ownership:** Cultivate trusted executive relationships with distributor business owners and leadership teams, ensuring Siemens Digital industries command dominant shelf-space, priority stocking, and mindshare over competing brands.

* **Channel Conflict Management & Rules of Engagement:** Establish, uphold, and govern clear Rules of Engagement (RoE) between industrial distributors, System Integrators, and Direct Accounts, eliminating price cannibalization, protecting partner margins, and ensuring healthy channel co-existence.

* **Distributor Profiling & Tiering:** Evaluate and categorize distribution partners based on technical capability, financial health, sales force competency, and warehouse infrastructure, establishing tailored development roadmaps for each partner tier.

  

**2. Sales Realization, Inventory Management & Demand Fulfillment (Sell-in & Sell-through)**

* **Drive Primary (Sell-in) and Secondary (Sell-through) Sales:** Own the complete distribution revenue realization cycle—driving high-velocity flow/run-rate business and balancing distributor stock replenishment (Sell-in) with actual market consumption (Sell-through / POS) across Digital Industries portfolio

* **Optimize Inventory Health & Stock Profiling:** Guide distributors on optimal inventory profiling, core product stocking matrices, fast-moving catalogue items, Days of Inventory on Hand (DOH), and buffer stock levels; proactively monitor, manage, and liquidate aging and slow-moving stock.

* **Order Fulfillment & Supply Chain Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with internal customer service, logistics, and factory supply chain teams to track order backlogs, monitor component lead times, expedite critical customer dispatches, and ensure high on-time delivery (OTD) performance.

* **Special Price Agreements (SPA) & Project Pricing:** Rigorously evaluate, structure, and steer distributor SPA and project discount requests, balancing aggressive market win-rates against regional price realization, margin thresholds, and price stability.

* **Working Capital & Credit Risk Management:** Partner with commercial and finance teams to actively monitor distributor credit lines, receivables aging, payment discipline, and cash flow health, ensuring complete financial compliance and minimal credit risk.

* **Counter & Walk-in Sales Velocity:** Accelerate over-the-counter and catalogue sales velocity for standard automation and drive components by establishing rapid quotation and dispatch workflows within distributor branches.

**3. Market Penetration, Technical Enablement & Channel Demand Generation**

* **Distributor Technical Enablement & Competence Building:** Drive systematic technical training and certification programs for distributor sales engineers, application specialists, and counter staff on product sizing tools (including but not limited to TIA Selection Tool, DT Configurator), basic PLC engineering (TIA Portal), drive parameterization, and competitive conversions.

* **Counter Marketing & Point-of-Sale (POS) Branding:** Elevate distributor branch, counter, and showroom visibility through professional product demo boards, live interactive demonstration kits, promotional displays, and point-of-sale branding to capture walk-in and trade demand.

* **Distributor Counter Days & Customer Tech Clinics:** Co-host regular 'Distributor Counter Days', product clinics, and technical workshops to introduce new PLC, HMI, and Drive innovations to local contractors, machine builders, panel builders, and plant maintenance teams.

* **Joint Customer Engagement & Field Sales Support:** Lead joint field sales calls with distributor sales teams targeting local machine builders (OEMs), panel shops, and industrial MRO accounts to qualify opportunities, position technical value, and secure deal conversions.

* **Promotional Blitzes & Secondary Demand Campaigns:** Design and deploy focused regional promotional campaigns, trade incentives, product bundle packages (e.g., Micro-PLC + HMI + Drive starter kits), and digital outreach programs to stimulate secondary demand.

* **Competitive Intelligence & Voice of Market:** Continuously monitor and report competitor moves—including pricing trends, distributor discount levels, stock availability, and lead-time dynamics from competitors (Rockwell, Schneider Electric, ABB, Mitsubishi, Omron, Delta)—providing actionable feedback to regional leadership.

  

**4. POS Analytics, CRM/PRM & Channel Operations**

* **Point-of-Sale (POS) Data Management & Analytics:** Enforce disciplined, timely, and granular POS data reporting from all authorized distributors; analyze secondary sales data to uncover end-customer buying patterns, vertical demand trends, repeat orders, and untapped accounts.

* **Demand Forecasting & S&OP Alignment:** Translate POS consumption trends, channel inventory levels, open pipeline, and run-rate signals into high-accuracy rolling monthly and quarterly sales forecasts, directly feeding regional Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP).

* **PRM & CRM System Excellence:** Ensure comprehensive logging and tracking of distributor master data, SPA approvals, project registrations, pipeline opportunities, and performance metrics within PRM (Partner Relationship Management) and Salesforce CRM systems.

* **Distributor Performance Scorecards & Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR):** Conduct structured, data-driven Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) evaluating distributor performance against key KPIs—including sales targets, POS growth, stock turns, new customer acquisition, training certifications, and policy compliance.

* **Market Development Fund (MDF) Governance:** Oversee the allocation, execution, and ROI tracking of Market Development Funds (MDF) allocated for distributor marketing initiatives, trade shows, promotional literature, and customer engagement events.

**Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience:**

* **Education Qualifications:** B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / Mechatronics Engineering. A Post-Graduate Diploma along with experience in Distribution and Supply Chain Management is a strong advantage.

* **Professional Experience:** Minimum 10+ years of demonstrable experience in Channel Sales / Distribution Management, with a proven track record of handling authorized industrial distributors in the Industrial Automation, PLCs, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs / AC Drives).

* **Distribution Economics & Commercial Acumen:** Deep expertise in industrial distribution business models, including Sell-in vs. Sell-through dynamics, distributor working capital, inventory turn ratios (DOH), commercial rebate structures, discount cascading, and credit governance.

* **Automation & Drives Technical Depth:** Strong working knowledge of Digital industries portfolio - including but not limited to Factory Automation & Motion Control architectures: PLCs (micro, compact, and modular), HMIs, Variable Frequency Drives (standard and modular VFDs), Servo systems, Decentralized I/O, Industrial Ethernet (Profinet), and digital selection tools (TIA Selection Tool, Sizer/DT Configurator).

* **Channel Leadership & Conflict Resolution:** Demonstrated leadership in cultivating high-trust relationships with distributor business owners/principals, driving team motivation, and resolving multi-channel sales conflicts with diplomacy and commercial firmness.

* **Analytical & Operational Capabilities:** Strong competency in analyzing POS datasets, sales funnels, and inventory reports using CRM/PRM platforms (Salesforce) and MS Excel / PowerBI; exceptional communication, presentation, and collaborative negotiation skills.
