title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers.  
  
We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about.  
  
Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number.  
  
We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to want to help us build reliable agents that runs real businesses, we're excited to meet you!

### **About the role:**

Our customers use paid advertising to generate leads and grow their businesses. The Performance Marketing Specialist owns the execution and continuous improvement of these campaigns across Meta and Google.

You will work directly with customers to understand their business, translate their objectives into campaign strategies, take campaigns live and continuously improve performance.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You are expected to understand the numbers, make decisions, identify opportunities and execute experiments. The focus is on improving campaign outcomes, not simply managing campaigns or reporting performance.

### **What you'll do:**

* Own customer campaigns end to end, from understanding requirements and setting up accounts to launching and managing campaigns.
* Understand each customer's business, industry, target audience and objectives to develop relevant campaign strategies.
* Manage and optimize campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads, including budgets, targeting, bidding, audiences and campaign structures.
* Continuously monitor campaign performance, identify opportunities and implement optimisations to improve metrics such as CPL, CPA, conversion rates and lead quality.
* Ideate and execute experiments across creatives, messaging, ad formats, audiences, targeting and campaign strategies.
* Explore different creative approaches and formats, including Reels, videos and variations in messaging, to improve campaign performance.
* Communicate directly with customers, understand their feedback, explain campaign performance and align on optimisation plans.
* Take ownership of campaign outcomes and proactively identify issues and opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.

### **What you have:**

### **Must-haves**

* Hands-on experience running and managing campaigns on both Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Experience independently setting up, launching, monitoring and optimising campaigns.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate campaign data into actionable decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in customer-facing situations.
* Strong account and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership, bias towards execution and the ability to independently drive things to completion.
* Ability to understand different industries and customer behaviours and adapt campaign strategies accordingly. There is no single optimisation playbook that works for every business.
  

### **Good to have**

* Minimum 2 years of genuine hands-on performance marketing experience.
* Experience running lead-generation campaigns.
* Experience with creative strategy and performance-driven ad experimentation.
* Prior experience in a digital marketing agency or managing multiple customer accounts.
* Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads Manager, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking.

### **Why you'll love us:**

* You'll be part of an early team at a fast-growing company, with a lot of impact
* You'll get to work with really smart and helpful people
* We constantly adopt the latest technologies and stay close to the latest ai innovations
* Opportunity to influence the direction of the product and engineering culture
* Flexible PTO policy
* Unlimited ai usage
* Plus cool swag, a stocked pantry, and other benefits

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The role responsible for driving portfolio growth, market development, new product launches, lifecycle management, and customer engagement. * Drive revenue growth, market share expansion, and profitability across product lines.
* Develop pricing strategies, business plans, demand forecasts, and margin improvement initiatives.
* Conduct periodic business reviews with leadership and monitor portfolio performance.
* Identify opportunities for menu expansion, installed-base growth, reagent utilization enhancement, and cost optimization.
* Develop long-term portfolio strategy aligned with market trends and customer needs.

  + Immunoassay reagent menus
  + Integrated Biochemistry-Immunology systems
  + Automation and workflow solutions

  + Supply chain and inventory planning
  + Go-to-market strategy
  + Sales enablement programs
  + Application and product training

* Immunology and Chemiluminescence Immunoassay (CLIA) technologies
* Automated Immunology analyzers and assay platforms
* Integrated Biochemistry-Immunology solutions

  + Thyroid markers
  + Fertility and reproductive hormones
  + Tumor markers
  + Cardiac markers
  + Bone metabolism markers
  + Infectious disease markers
  + Autoimmune markers
  + Vitamin and anemia markers

* Pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical laboratory workflows

* NABL, CAP, ISO 15189 and laboratory accreditation requirements

* Key customer interactions
* Product evaluations
* Scientific discussions
* KOL engagements
* Product demonstrations
* Strategic sales opportunities

  + Market development programs
  + Digital marketing initiatives
  + Scientific marketing activities
  + Customer education programs

* Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities.
* Support national sales teams in achieving business objectives.

  + Field sales and application teams for menu expansion and innovation roadmap
  + Regulatory and Quality teams for compliance
  + Manufacturing for supply planning and cost optimization
  + Sales teams for market development
  + Marketing teams for brand and portfolio growth
  + Finance for forecasting and profitability management
  + Technical service team for installation excellence and customer support

  + Standalone diagnostic laboratories
  + Hospital laboratories
  + Corporate laboratory chains
  + Specialty diagnostic centers
  + Institutions of National Importance
* Build relationships with:
  + Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs)
  + Laboratory Directors
  + Pathologists
  + Clinical Biochemists
  + Procurement stakeholders
* Gather market insights and customer feedback to drive portfolio improvements and strategic initiatives.
* Represent the company at conferences, workshops, scientific meetings, and industry events.

**Critical Competencies**

* Strong strategic marketing and product management capability
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong scientific and commercial acumen
* Exceptional stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Gentle yet firm leadership style with strong execution focus
* High ownership, accountability, and business orientation
* Strong analytical and financial management capability
* Ability to simplify complex scientific concepts for commercial audiences

title: Senior Manager Customer Experience
description:
**Senior Manager, Customer Experience**
=======================================

**Company:** Supertails, Bengaluru (in office)

**Reports to:** Head of Customer Experience

**Teams you run:** The order support desk, Clinic booking and calling team, Super companion team, Online consultation veterinary doctors, Sales teams along with Quality & Training and Analytics teams

**About Supertails**

Supertails is one of India's fastest-growing integrated pet-care platforms. We are not just an online store. We are building everything a pet parent needs in one place:

* A wide product catalogue across hundreds of brands
* India's largest digital pet pharmacy
* Vet consultations through a large team of in-house veterinarians
* A Fear-Free certified clinic network
* Express delivery in multiple cities

Every one of these businesses creates customer contacts: an order that is late, a prescription that needs a vet's sign-off, a clinic slot that has to be booked, a new pet parent who needs a hand in the first weeks. The Customer Experience team handles all of them.

**Our CX team**
---------------

Our CX team is not a cost centre that answers tickets. It is the part of the company that sees every broken process first, fixes it at the root, and turns the rest into bookings, repeat orders and reviews. We build a good part of our own tooling, and we use AI wherever it answers a customer faster and better than a queue would.

Over the last quarter the team cut contacts per 100 orders by 24% and cost per contact by 21%, mostly by fixing root causes upstream with supply chain and product and by moving simple contacts to bots. The next leg is harder. The contacts that remain need judgment, and the plan for the coming quarters assumes bots and automation carry more of the load with a team that does not grow with volume.

**The role**
------------

We are looking for the second-most senior person in the function: someone who runs the operation day to day and builds the systems that make it cheaper and better every month.

You have run the morning queue review on Monday, shipped a Retool dashboard or a Claude Code script on Wednesday, and presented a cost-per-contact plan to leadership on Friday. That is the mix.

You will own all customer-facing support operations. Assistant managers and team leads report to you. You report to a product-minded CX leader and work daily with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Category and Marketing.

**Pillar 1: Run the operation**
-------------------------------

You own the numbers and the people behind them.

* **Numbers you own:** contacts per 100 orders; cost per contact; resolution time and first response time; CSAT, answer rate and abandonment on inbound lines; schedule adherence and agent attrition; bookings per 100 tickets and show rate for clinic calling; recovered revenue and return on spends.
* Daily, weekly and monthly running of every pod: rosters, shrinkage, queue health, escalations, quality audits and coaching through the team leads.
* Seven-day coverage and festival-peak planning. You are the escalation point for outages, founder escalations, social media and consumer-forum complaints.
* A weekly operating review with a one-page view per pod: goal, actual, gap, and what changes this week.
* Hire and grow assistant managers, team leads and subject experts, and manage performance, including exits. Build a bench so no pod depends on one person.
* Make quality and training work for every pod, not only the biggest one: scoring for calls, chats and emails, calibration sessions, and feedback loops that change what agents do.
* Customer data handling on a pharmacy floor: call-recording consent, prescription data and the data protection law, agreed with Legal and enforced on the floor.

**Pillar 2: Build the tools, the automation and the roadmap**
-------------------------------------------------------------

You are not a full-stack engineer, but you are technical enough to ship on your own and you do not wait for engineering time.

* Build internal tools and dashboards with low-code platforms (Retool, Appsmith), AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor) and cloud services (GCP Cloud Run, Firebase). Give leadership a live view of CX health and emerging issues.
* Own the integrations between our CX platforms (Nugget for tickets and bots, Ameyo and Exotel for telephony, or their equivalents), the CRM, and our analytics database, through APIs, webhooks and middleware.
* Prototype and ship the AI pieces: smart routing, auto-tagging, auto-refunds, agent assist, chatbot and voice-bot improvements. Own the bot and self-serve roadmap with Product: which contact types move, in what order, and what the quality bar is.
* Keep a CX technology roadmap tied to company goals: what to build, buy or shut down, and when. Decide on speed and plain economics.
* Drive cost per contact down through automation, self-serve and smarter routing, without giving up quality. Know what you would refuse to cut.
* Monitor system health, debug integration failures and keep the critical CX workflows up. Keep the documentation current.

**Pillar 3: Fix the processes**
-------------------------------

You know what a good support floor looks like, from ticket routing to agent training to quality frameworks.

* Audit and redesign workflows across support, sales and onboarding to cut friction, shorten resolution and raise CSAT.
* Write and enforce the standard operating procedures for the messy cases: unresolved delivery tickets, refunds, resends, duplicate orders, prescription holds. Build them so they hold at twice today's volume.
* Keep a dated list of root-cause projects, each with an assumed and an actual impact on contacts per 100 orders, reviewed every week with Product, Supply Chain and Category. Be the person who shows up with the number that proves a customer problem exists.
* Manage the vendors: the outsourced calling partner, telephony, ticketing and bots. You own the service levels, the invoices and the renewals.

**Pillar 4: Grow the revenue lines**
------------------------------------

* Clinic bookings from the calling team, Revenue recovery, proactive outreach, and upsell flows that customers thank us for.
* New channels (WhatsApp, in-app chat) and differentiated service by customer segment.

**What the first 90 days look like**
------------------------------------

* **Days 1 to 30:** sit in every queue. Know every pod's volume, staffing, cost and quality by heart. Run the weekly review by week four.
* **Days 31 to 60:** publish the root-cause project list with owners and dates. Fix the two or three broken metric definitions that stop us reading our own numbers the same way twice. Ship one tool.
* **Days 61 to 90:** present the next quarter's plan for your pods: contacts, cost, quality, staffing and automation, with the assumptions written down and a view on what you would cut or add.

**You should apply if**
-----------------------

* You have 7 to 10 years in CX operations, CX technology, business operations or a hybrid role at a D2C, e-commerce, quick-commerce, consumer internet or healthcare company.
* You have managed managers, not only agents, on a multi-channel floor of 50 or more seats (voice, chat, email, bots). You have hired team leads.
* You have owned a cost line, not only a service level. You can explain cost per contact, how you brought it down, and what broke along the way.
* You build, you do not only manage tools. You have shipped internal tools, automated workflows or integrations on your own, using low-code platforms, APIs or scripting.
* You read your own data. Comfortable with SQL, spreadsheets and BI tools. You do not wait for an analyst to tell you what happened yesterday.
* You have configured, customised or integrated at least one CX platform: Nugget, Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom, Ameyo, Exotel, Genesys or similar.
* You can write a clear SOP, present a plan to leadership and explain a technical decision to a non-technical colleague, all in the same day. Plain, direct English. Hindi or Kannada helps on the floor.
* You are in Bengaluru and in the office with the team.

**Good to have**

* You have run a floor of 100 or more seats.
* You can deploy a small service on Cloud Run or its AWS equivalent and run a simple data pipeline.
* You have run an outsourced vendor or taken a team through a telephony or ticketing platform change.
* Pet care, healthcare or pharmacy experience, or any category where the customer is anxious and the stakes are real.
* Experience setting up a clinic or appointment-based calling team.

**How we will assess you**
--------------------------

* A 30-minute screening call on your operating history: teams, volumes, costs, tools you built, what you changed.
* A take-home case built on a closed past quarter's actuals (masked): a contact-mix, staffing and automation problem. You present your plan and defend it.
* Interviews with the Head of Customer Experience, Heads of Product and Supply Chain and a founder conversation.

**What you will get**
---------------------

* A seat where you build, operate and plan at the same time. One approver.. You own the rest.
* Direct impact on how pet parents experience Supertails, from the first order to the clinic visit.
* A Bengaluru office with a team that likes being in the office together. Yes, there are office dogs.

title: VP, Internal Audit
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. **Job Description:**

Blackstone Internal Audit provides independent assurance to executive management and the Blackstone Audit Committee regarding the effectiveness of the Firm’s governance, risk management, and internal control processes. Additionally, BXIA facilitates Blackstone’s SOX Compliance Program by providing oversight, expertise, and support with management’s assessment of the effectiveness of its internal controls over financial reporting. We are seeking a highly motivated VP to lead the Bangalore-based internal audit, SOX and risk advisory activities, providing oversight of deliverables, talent development, stakeholder engagement, and transformation initiatives. The VP will play a critical role in strengthening the Firm’s control environment through a risk-based approach to assurance, while supporting broader Internal Audit objectives and enterprise-wide governance initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:** The BXIA VP will drive key activities undertaken by the Center of Excellence (COE) Internal Audit and SOX teams.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* BXIA COE Team Lead: Lead our COE team of captive and third-party resources in delivery of internal audit, SOX, risk advisory, and audit operations activities, demonstrating accountability and ownership of key deliverables of the team.
* Audit Execution Oversight: Support delivery and oversight of COE internal audit activities, including execution of risk-based audits of business, enterprise, and technology processes across Blackstone's global businesses.
* SOX Program Execution Oversight: Support delivery and oversight of COE SOX program execution activities across each phase of the program, including, planning, documentation, testing and reporting.
* Audit Operations Oversight: Oversee the delivery of audit operations support delivered by the COE, including analytics, dashboards, AI use case development, automation, and operational reporting.
* Quality Review of Deliverables: Oversee the quality and consistency of controls testing, documentation, and related assurance activities performed by the COE across Internal Audit, SOX, risk advisory, and special projects, ensuring adherence to methodology, quality standards, and continuous improvement objectives.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build relationships with key stakeholders; understand their operating and risk environments and serve as a trusted point of contact.
* Innovation & Strategic Initiatives: Drive operational improvements across the COE while supporting key departmental initiatives and overseeing COE resources contributing to strategic projects and special initiatives.
* Team & Talent Development: Drive a high-performance, values-based team culture by motivating, mentoring, coaching, skill-based training and developing team members in alignment with Blackstone principles.
* COE Operations, Resource & Project Management Oversight: Lead resource allocation, capacity planning, project prioritization and delivery monitoring across COE to ensure resources are deployed effectively, priorities are met, risks are escalated, and deliverables are completed timely and in accordance with established expectations.
* Global BXIA Team Partnership: Partner strategically with the Global Internal Audit team by defining the COE team’s objectives in alignment with BXIA’s broader strategy, vision, and operating model.

**Qualifications:** Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who are highly motivated, intelligently curious, and have demonstrated excellence in their prior endeavors. The ideal candidate will bring a passion for building and leading a top-tier Controls, Risk, and Assurance Center of Excellence, deep expertise in internal audit, SOX, risk management, and controls, a selfstarter mentality, and the ability to independently solve complex problems. Strong communication, project management, stakeholder management, and attention to detail are equally important as technical expertise. Successful candidates will have the following attributes:

  

* Educated: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field. CPA preferred; MBA, CIA, CFA, or CISA a plus.
* Experienced: 12+ years of external audit and/or internal audit experience within the Big Four, a similarly recognized global public accounting or consulting firm, or global financial services organization. Additional experience with SOX compliance is preferred.
* Technically Proficient: Demonstrated understanding and practical application of risk and control frameworks (e.g., IIA Standards, ICFR requirements, COSO framework, GAAP).
* Proven Leader: Experience leading teams and managing global or shared-service delivery models, with a strong focus on developing junior talent, fostering team cohesion, and operating effectively within a US-based global organization.
* Sound Judgement: Demonstrated ability to exercise sound risk-based judgment, prioritize competing risks and business needs, and effectively manage upward through timely communication and escalation of significant issues, risks, and decisions.
* Curious & Self-Directed: Ability to stay informed on industry best practices, technology, global markets, and internal audit and ICFR practices; operates with a high degree of autonomy and sound judgment. • Integrity-Driven: Committed to the highest personal and professional standards.
* Analytically Sound: Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills; transformation initiatives, data analytics experience, data visualization tools or audit testing and risk monitoring a plus.

title: Creative Director, Copy
description:
#### **Location:**

Bangalore

#### **Experience:**

10+ years, including 3+ years in creative leadership

#### **About the Role**

We are looking for a strategic, business-minded Creative Director, Copy who can turn creative thinking into compelling brand stories, impactful campaigns, and new business opportunities.

This role goes beyond leading a copy team. You will work closely with our Sales, Business Development, and Client Services teams to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts, develop proactive creative ideas, pitch new solutions, and help win new business.

You will lead creative strategy, storytelling, and content development for B2B brands, primarily targeting the US market. The ideal candidate combines exceptional creative judgment, strong business acumen, persuasive presentation skills, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into ideas that drive measurable results.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires complete ownership of creative quality, team performance, client relationships, and contributions to business growth.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Creative Strategy & Direction**

* Lead creative strategy, copy direction, and storytelling across integrated B2B marketing campaigns, digital experiences, video, and sales enablement assets.
* Develop compelling campaign concepts, brand narratives, messaging frameworks, value propositions, and positioning strategies.
* Translate complex technology, products, and business challenges into clear, differentiated, and persuasive communication.
* Partner with design, UX/UI, video, and marketing teams to deliver cohesive, high-impact creative solutions.
* Guide creative development from concept through execution, ensuring originality, strategic relevance, and exceptional quality.
* Ensure all communication meets US English standards and resonates with North American business audiences.

#### **2. Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Partner closely with Sales and Business Development teams to develop creative strategies that help win new business.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client accounts through proactive campaign ideas, content solutions, and creative recommendations.
* Develop compelling creative concepts, pitch narratives, and presentations that demonstrate business value and growth opportunities.
* Participate in client discovery meetings, strategic workshops, new business pitches, and executive-level presentations.
* Collaborate with Sales and Client Services teams to convert creative opportunities into clearly defined, commercially viable proposals.
* Understand client business objectives, competitive landscapes, and market trends to recommend new creative solutions.
* Contribute to revenue growth through stronger client engagement, account expansion, and new business wins.

#### **3. Client Leadership & Strategic Partnership**

* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders by bringing strategic thinking, creative expertise, and proactive recommendations.
* Lead creative discussions and confidently present concepts, messaging strategies, and campaign recommendations.
* Challenge briefs constructively, identify opportunities beyond the initial scope, and recommend solutions that deliver greater business impact.
* Partner with account and strategy teams to align creative recommendations with client objectives, audience insights, and marketing performance.
* Take ownership of creative direction, stakeholder alignment, and resolution of critical client feedback.

#### **4. Team Leadership & Creative Excellence**

* Lead, mentor, and develop copywriters, strengthening their conceptual thinking, storytelling, writing, and presentation skills.
* Establish high standards for creativity, editorial quality, accountability, and timely delivery.
* Review and guide content across campaigns, websites, video scripts, presentations, and marketing and sales enablement collateral.
* Ensure all deliverables are accurate, brand-aligned, strategically relevant, and client-ready.
* Foster a culture of creative ownership, continuous improvement, collaboration, and innovation.
* Work with project managers and cross-functional leaders to manage priorities, resources, and delivery quality.

#### **5. AI-Powered Creative Innovation**

* Champion the adoption of AI tools and workflows to accelerate creative ideation, content development, research, and production.
* Guide teams in using AI to generate stronger creative concepts, improve productivity, and deliver scalable content solutions.
* Identify and eliminate generic, repetitive, inaccurate, or low-quality AI-generated content.
* Combine human creativity, strategic thinking, and AI capabilities to develop distinctive brand communication.
* Explore AI-powered creative solutions that can be packaged and pitched as new services to existing and prospective clients.
* Maintain editorial quality, originality, brand consistency, and human accountability across all AI-assisted work.

#### **6. Creative Performance & Business Impact**

* Develop messaging strategies aligned with B2B buyer journeys, demand generation, account-based marketing, and sales enablement.
* Collaborate with performance marketing and strategy teams to improve campaign effectiveness and conversion.
* Use audience insights, competitive research, and campaign performance data to strengthen creative recommendations.
* Connect creative ideas to measurable business outcomes, including engagement, lead generation, conversion, and account growth.
* Contribute to pitches, proposals, and creative scoping while balancing quality, timelines, and commercial viability.

#### **Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in copywriting, creative strategy, or integrated marketing, preferably within a digital or creative agency.
* Minimum 3 years of experience leading copywriters or multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Proven experience developing creative strategies and campaigns for B2B brands, particularly for US and North American markets.
* **Exceptional command of US English**, with outstanding storytelling, conceptual writing, editing, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute to new business pitches, client presentations, and account growth opportunities.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect creative solutions to client challenges and commercial objectives.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns, brand narratives, video scripts, digital experiences, and marketing and sales enablement content.
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing, demand generation, buyer journeys, and conversion-focused messaging.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior client stakeholders, sales leaders, and executive teams.
* Proven leadership skills with a strong focus on accountability, mentoring, creative quality, and delivery excellence.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools for creative development, content production, and workflow optimization.
* Strong portfolio showcasing creative thinking, campaign storytelling, strategic messaging, and business impact.

#### **Good to Have**

* Experience working with B2B technology, SaaS, AI, cybersecurity, healthcare, or enterprise brands.
* Experience partnering directly with Sales and Business Development teams to win new business.
* Demonstrated success in identifying and converting upsell or cross-sell opportunities.
* Experience leading high-value client pitches, strategic workshops, and executive presentations.
* Understanding of account-based marketing, demand generation, SEO, AEO, and content performance.
* Experience developing thought leadership, executive communications, product narratives, and video storytelling.
* Experience building AI-powered content workflows and scalable creative solutions.

#### **What We’re Looking For**

We are not looking for someone who only manages copywriters or reviews content.

We are looking for a **creative leader who thinks like a strategist, presents like a storyteller, and approaches opportunities with a business growth mindset.**

Someone who can walk into a client meeting, understand the business challenge, develop a compelling creative idea, and confidently pitch a solution that creates value for the client and growth opportunities for Position².

Above all, we want someone who takes complete ownership of their work, inspires the team to deliver exceptional creative, and plays an active role in winning and growing client business.

title: Technical Implementation Lead
description:
**About Lifesight**
===================

**Lifesight** is a pioneering Unified **Marketing Measurement (UMM)** platform which helps marketers measure, plan and optimise their marketing spend. In a world of fragmented data, unreliable cookies, and outdated reporting, we empower modern businesses to achieve predictable, sustained growth by aligning marketing and finance on a single causal truth.

We are at the forefront of **Agentic Unified Marketing Measurement**. Moving beyond siloed tools and post facto dashboards, our AI-driven causal engine combines Causal MMM, Incrementality testing and Incrementality Adjusted Attribution to create a finance ready marketing decision system.

### **Why We Exist**

Our mission is to eliminate wasted ad spend and remove the guesswork from marketing. Operating as an independent, unbiased measurement layer, Lifesight enables CMOs, CFOs, and performance marketers to confidently answer the only question that matters: *What is the true incremental value of my marketing spend?*

**Join the Future of Decision Intelligence.** We are transforming marketing from a gamble into a science. By joining Lifesight, you will help build the intelligent, agent-ready infrastructure that powers data-driven, optimized decisions for hundreds of top global brands.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

As the Lead – Technical Implementation on our global Solutions team in Bangalore, you'll lead a team of Technical Implementation Specialists and own data onboarding for Lifesight's Unified Marketing Measurement solutions: **Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)**, **Incrementality Experiments**, and **Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)**.

You'll set the standard for how client data gets into Lifesight: scoped clearly, delivered on time, and accurate from day one. This role is for a hands-on leader who can coach a team, run multiple client onboardings in parallel, and speak with equal confidence to a client's data engineer and their CMO.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Lead the team**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of Technical Implementation Specialists; set priorities, review their work, and raise the bar on quality.
* Allocate client onboardings across the team based on complexity, capacity, and skills; step in hands-on when an engagement needs it.
* Build and maintain standard playbooks, checklists, and templates for data onboarding across MMM, Experiments, and MTA.
* Run regular 1:1s and team reviews; give clear feedback and support each specialist's growth.

### **Own data onboarding for MMM, Experiments, and MTA**

* Own end-to-end data onboarding for every client: scoping data requirements, validating pipelines, testing configurations, and signing off on measurement readiness.
* Define what "model-ready" data looks like for each solution: historical spend, KPI, and control variables for MMM; geo and audience-level data for Experiments; event, touchpoint, and conversion data for MTA.
* Oversee how the team combines, cleans, and transforms fragmented, multi-source data across Excel, SQL, and BigQuery.
* Catch data quality issues early (type mismatches, schema inconsistencies, integration gaps, anomalies, outliers) before they affect client outcomes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex implementation issues using internal tooling, APIs, and cross-functional collaboration.

### **Manage projects and timelines**

* Translate client requirements into structured implementation plans with clear milestones, owners, and dates.
* Run multiple onboardings in parallel; track progress, manage dependencies, and keep every project on schedule.
* Spot risks early, escalate with a proposed fix, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Report onboarding status, timelines, and blockers to leadership and client teams.

### **Be the client's trusted technical partner**

* Act as the senior technical point of contact and escalation point for clients during onboarding.
* Lead client calls and workshops; explain data requirements and measurement concepts in plain business language.
* Manage expectations, negotiate scope and timelines, and maintain trust through every engagement.
* Run account health checks and flag risks before they escalate.

### **Improve how we work**

* Use AI tools and prompt engineering to streamline workflows and automate repetitive onboarding tasks across the team.
* Feed structured client and team feedback into Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and tooling.
* Partner with Data Science, Customer Success, and Sales for smooth handoffs from pre-sales through to model delivery.

**P.S.** – The above list need not put a ceiling on your aspirations at Lifesight.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in technical implementation, data onboarding, solutioning, or solutions consulting within B2B SaaS; ideally in data, martech, or adtech.
* 2+ years leading small teams (3–6 people) of implementation, solutions, or data specialists, including hiring, coaching, and performance feedback.
* Strong client-facing experience: you've owned onboardings end to end and been the go-to technical contact for enterprise clients.
* Excellent business communication: you write clearly, present with confidence, and adapt your message for engineers, marketers, and executives alike.
* Excellent project management: you run several projects at once, plan milestones, manage dependencies, and deliver on time. Experience with tools like Jira, Asana, or similar.
* Proven ability to scope complex client requirements and turn them into structured, actionable implementation plans.
* Hands-on experience combining, cleaning, and transforming fragmented, multi-format data using Excel, SQL, and BigQuery; Python or JavaScript is a plus.
* Sharp data hygiene instincts; you spot type errors, schema mismatches, and structural inconsistencies, and teach your team to do the same.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, Google Cloud (BigQuery), and SQL-based transformation workflows.
* Active user of AI tools and prompt engineering techniques (Few-Shot Prompting, Role/Persona Prompting, etc.), and keen to drive their adoption across the team.
* First principles thinking. You take ownership, challenge assumptions, and don't let blockers sit, for yourself or your team.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Direct experience onboarding data for Marketing Mix Models, Incrementality Experiments (geo or audience holdouts), or Multi-Touch Attribution.
* Familiarity with Tag Managers, JS Pixels / SDKs, server-side tracking, AdTech, DSPs, or marketing attribution tools.
* Familiarity with ad platforms and their data exports and APIs: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic, and similar ad networks.
* Experience building scalable onboarding processes or internal tooling for a growing implementation team.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar project management certification.

title: Technical Lead - Salesforce Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud Personalization (MCP)
description:
The purpose of this role is to maintain, improve, clean and manipulate data in the business’s operational and analytics databases. The Data Engineer works with the business’s software engineers, data analytics teams, data scientists and data warehouse engineers in order to understand and aid in the implementation of database requirements, analyse performance, and troubleshoot any existent issues.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Technical Lead to architect and deliver customer engagement solutions leveraging both Salesforce Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud Personalization (MCP). This role is ideal for professionals with deep expertise in creating unified customer profiles, real-time personalization strategies, and data-driven marketing experiences across digital channels.  
The successful candidate will lead the design of scalable data and personalization architectures, oversee data ingestion, identity resolution, audience activation, and real-time decisioning, while ensuring seamless integration between Data Cloud, MCP, and the broader MarTech ecosystem. This role requires close collaboration with marketing, analytics, product, and engineering teams to drive highly personalized customer experiences and measurable business outcomes.

**Must have skills**

1. Hands-on implementation experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud Personalization (MCP), including architecture, configuration, and deployment of real-time personalization solutions such as Open-Time Email (OTE) campaigns, web and mobile personalization, product recommendations, decisioning strategies, audience segmentation, and behavioral targeting.  
2. Strong expertise in Data Cloud capabilities, including data ingestion, identity resolution, profile unification, audience segmentation, and activation.  
3. Proven experience designing and implementing real-time personalization use cases using MCP, Interaction Studio, and behavioral customer data.  
4. Strong understanding of customer journey orchestration across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including Journey Builder and MCP-driven engagement strategies.  
5. Experience with consent management, customer profile stitching, and customer data platform (CDP) best practices.  
6. Proficiency in API integrations (REST, SOAP), event-driven architectures, and data connectors.  
7. Strong skills in SQL, Python, or JavaScript for data transformation, automation, and personalization use cases.  
8. Experience integrating Data Cloud and MCP with enterprise MarTech platforms, CRMs, analytics solutions, and digital experience platforms.  
9. Knowledge of data governance, privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), and performance optimization for large-scale customer data environments.

**Good to have skills**

1. Experience with Salesforce CRM, Service Cloud, or Commerce Cloud  
2. Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and big data technologies  
3. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and containerization  
4. Client-facing experience and ability to lead technical discussions with stakeholders  
5. Familiarity with audience segmentation, journey orchestration, and personalization strategies

**Key responsibiltes**

1. Lead the technical design and implementation of Salesforce Data Cloud solutions  
2. Architect data models and ingestion pipelines for unified customer profiles  
3. Integrate Data Cloud with MCP and other MarTech platforms for activation and personalization  
4. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions  
5. Guide development teams in building reusable components and automation scripts  
6. Ensure data quality, performance optimization, and privacy compliance  
7. Troubleshoot complex data and integration issues across platforms  
8. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical standards and best practices  
9. Support audience creation, segmentation, and journey orchestration workflows  
10. Evaluate emerging technologies and contribute to roadmap planning for Data Cloud adoption

Education Qulification

Bachelors in Engineering with a specialisation in Computer Science, Data , IT  
Graduate from other fields with good communication and analytical skills

Certification If Any

Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant  
Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Consultant  
Marketing Cloud Personalization Accredited Professional  
Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer  
Salesforce Certified Administrator  
Salesforce Certified Agent force Specialist

Shift timing

12 PM - 10 PM

Bengaluru

**Brand:**

**Time Type:**

Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Drive medium-sized software releases from initial development through production release and beyond. You will lead cross-functional release core teams across Product Management, Engineering (Development, Test), Marketing, Operations, and Global Services; set your own priorities; recommend release tradeoffs; and influence stakeholders up to the Senior Director level. Your decisions carry limited to noticeable operational and financial impact, keeping releases predictable and high quality and directly shaping customer experience.

* **Own the plan:** Lead releases on schedule and with quality through the program life cycle. Lead schedule and resource planning to meet product requirements; plan, track, and manage scope, schedule, cost, resources, and risk; and merge disparate team and component plans into a single release plan.
* **Manage risk:** Identify risks to schedule, content, or quality, communicate them early, and develop mitigation plans. Know when help is needed and seek it.
* **Execute and go live:** Work with engineers and DevOps teams to understand the impact of branches and code merges; coordinate release-branch fixes and publish releases; lead and coordinate Go-Live activities and decisions, including deployment plans and checklists; and follow NetApp release and phase-review processes.
* **Use tools and metrics well:** Use release tools and processes correctly and model their use for the team throughout the release life cycle. Track and report progress with defined metrics (e.g., JIRA, Jenkins, qTest, PowerBI), and apply the release mission to day-to-day activities.
* **Communicate and influence:** Share all key plans, commitments, and changes (requirements, Test plans, schedule, scope); clearly report team results to immediate management; work with teammates to articulate, compare, and implement alternative approaches based on project management principles; and influence stakeholders outside your department.
* **Grow with the team:** Be a key, active member of the release team. Work independently on routine release work, with guidance from senior Release Managers on new assignments, building toward ownership of larger releases.
* **Explore AI-enabled automation:** Experiment with AI-driven automation to streamline release workflows (analysis, synthesis, decision support), and work with tools teams to understand evolving tooling capabilities and constraints and stay aligned with how Engineering is adopting them.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

* Proficient knowledge and experience in a specific area of engineering, with demonstrated release or project management ability
* Working knowledge of release management concepts, company policies and procedures, the product life cycle, development methodologies, and the technology area supported; understanding of industry practices a plus
* Ability to handle a mix of regular and unstructured tasks, with somewhat-defined processes and multiple interdependencies
* Clear written and verbal communication of plans, commitments, and changes to team members and management
* Technical competency ranging from moderate to subject matter expert
* Ability to work independently on routine work and to seek help when needed
* **Nice to have:** Hands-on experience with JIRA, qTest, PowerBI, and Jenkins; familiarity with automated configuration management and code management systems and with testing methodologies; experience using AI tools to improve productivity and analysis

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering discipline or business plus 5+ **years of experience**, or an entry-level MS with equivalent experience

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - Bangalore
description:
**Who Are We?**
---------------

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As RZR's first Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will build the product marketing function from the ground up. You will own positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and content marketing across RZR's platform — bringing a consistent, differentiated story to buyers across mobile gaming, performance advertising, and connected TV.

You will report directly to the Senior Director of Go-to-Market and Product Marketing and work closely with Product, Sales, and Brand. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role with direct accountability for commercial outcomes: sourced and influenced pipeline, sales readiness, and RZR's market positioning.

Your first major milestone is January SKO — you will own the agenda, revenue-enablement sessions, complete sales library, and certification kickoff. From there, you will operate on a quarterly cadence: aligning on three management-approved storylines, then executing the content strategy, campaign plan, and editorial calendar that bring them to market.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Positioning & Messaging**

* Complete the positioning overhaul and roll it out across the website, sales decks, one-pagers, and case studies — adapted by priority ICP and region, with validated product claims.
* Own launch plans and product playbooks across RZR's offerings; adapt messaging for direct growth teams and agency buyers.

### **Sales Enablement**

* Stand up and maintain a sales enablement library covering customer-facing proof, internal playbooks, competitive battlecards, and objection-handling guidance — with owners, version control, and review cycles.
* Build the sales certification program, SKO agenda, and enablement sessions; assess Sales during and after SKO and drive targeted coaching on identified gaps.

### **Content Marketing**

* Co-develop three management-aligned quarterly storylines and translate them into a content strategy, campaign plan, and editorial calendar.
* Produce recurring webinars, blog articles, quarterly data reports, practical guides, case studies, and expert interviews.
* Coordinate email and social distribution with the Brand team through a shared content, PMM, and events calendar.

### **Measurement & Reporting**

* Establish reporting on sourced and influenced opportunities and named-account engagement; agree definitions, attribution rules, and targets with revenue operations within your first 30 days.
* Report monthly on pipeline value, distinct influenced opportunities, and the share of named accounts engaging with content — keeping sourced and influenced cohorts separate.

**Required Skills and Experience**
----------------------------------

* 4–6 years of relevant adtech experience, with senior-level ownership of product marketing programs and delivery with limited ongoing direction.
* Demonstrated positioning judgment and personally authored English-language copy across product pages, one-pagers, case studies, and substantial thought leadership.
* Fluency in user acquisition, retargeting, and advertising performance metrics; ability to adapt messaging for advanced gaming teams and less technical agency or brand buyers.
* Evidence of building repeatable enablement and content programs — turning SME and customer insight into accurate, commercial content — and measuring outcomes.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; proven ability to work independently with Product, Sales, and Brand to resolve dependencies and ship on schedule.

**The RZR Code**
----------------

### **Our Values**

Our values define the company we want to be. They guide the decisions we make, the environment we create, and how we treat customers and each other.

* **Win with Customers:** We don't call it a win unless our clients win too. We earn long-term trust by putting their success at the center.
* **One Team:** No team wins when the company loses. We optimize for the company, not our function.
* **Challenge with Respect:** We say what we think and challenge ideas regardless of title. We are direct without being disrespectful.
* **Learn Forward:** Thoughtful experiments can fail; failing to learn from them cannot. Share what you learn.

### **Our Competencies**

Our competencies define what we expect from each of us. They describe the behaviors and capabilities we demonstrate in our day-to-day work.

* **Extreme Ownership:** Own the outcome end to end, including problems you didn't create.
* **Courage:** Speak up, make hard calls, and take thoughtful risks.
* **Move Fast:** Act with urgency and decide with the information available.
* **Curiosity:** Ask why, look for better ways, and keep learning.
* **Drive for Excellence:** Set a high bar for quality and keep raising it.
* **Deliver Results:** Focus on outcomes that move the business forward.
* **Proactive Communication:** Share information early, before anyone has to ask.
* **Manage Ambiguity:** Make progress when the path isn't clear.

**RZR is an equal opportunity employer**

RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

RZR provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

“**Uplift is our purpose.**

**Mitra is our promise**”

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an enthusiastic, confident, and customer-oriented Marketing & Customer Engagement Executive to support our business development and customer engagement activities.

The role involves connecting with prospective customers, following up on incoming enquiries and marketing leads, explaining UpliftMitra's services, generating customer interest, facilitating coaching/counselling appointments, and providing ongoing customer support.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, strong follow-up capabilities, and the ability to build trust with prospective customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lead Management & Follow-ups**

* Contact prospective customers through telephone calls, WhatsApp, and other communication channels.
* Follow up on leads generated through digital marketing, social media campaigns, website enquiries, and referrals.

**2. Service Promotion & Customer Engagement**

* Introduce and explain UpliftMitra's coaching and counselling services.
* Communicate the value proposition and benefits of personalized coaching and counselling.
* Respond to customer queries and address initial concerns professionally.
* Encourage prospective customers to book introductory sessions or consultations.
* Coordinate with coaches and counsellors to facilitate appointments and customer onboarding.

**3. Customer Support & Relationship Management**

* Act as the first point of contact for customer enquiries.
* Assist customers with appointment scheduling, session coordination, and basic service-related queries.
* Follow up with customers after sessions to understand their experience and satisfaction.
* Coordinate with the internal team and coaches to resolve customer concerns.
* Maintain professional, confidential, and empathetic communication with customers.

**4. Reporting & Performance Tracking**

* Track daily calls, leads contacted, follow-ups, appointments, and conversions.
* Provide regular updates on lead status and customer feedback.
* Maintain basic CRM or Excel-based lead management records.
* Work towards agreed monthly engagement and conversion targets.

**Candidate Profile**

* 2–3 years of experience in direct or telemarketing, telesales, customer support, inside sales, or lead management.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills, confidence, and a strong willingness to learn may also be considered.
* Excellent spoken English; knowledge of Hindi & any regional language will be an added advantage.
* Good telephone etiquette and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to understand customer needs and communicate service benefits effectively.
* Comfortable with WhatsApp, telephone calls, spreadsheets, and basic digital tools.
* Self-motivated, disciplined, target-oriented, and capable of working independently.
* Empathetic and patient approach when interacting with customers seeking personal or professional guidance.

**Work Arrangement & Engagement Model**

* Bangalore-based candidates preferred.
* Hybrid working arrangement with flexibility to work remotely and attend office meetings or review meetings with leadership team as and when required.
* Contract-based engagement.
* Flexible working schedule based on mutually agreed deliverables and business requirements.
* Performance-linked incentive structure based on qualified lead conversions, confirmed bookings, and customer acquisition.
* Opportunity to grow with an emerging coaching and counselling platform.

**Compensation & Incentives**

This is primarily an incentive-based engagement and based on the start-up progress, a fixed salary can be discussed for later.

The compensation model will be linked to measurable business outcomes, including:

* Successful conversion of prospective leads.
* Confirmed and paid customer bookings.
* Achievement of agreed monthly performance targets.
* Customer engagement and service coordination performance.

The detailed incentive structure will be discussed during the selection process.

**Why Join UpliftMitra?**

* Be part of an emerging platform focused on personal growth and well-being.
* Opportunity to contribute to a meaningful, people-centric business.
* Flexible hybrid working arrangement.
* Performance-driven earning potential.
* Opportunity to develop skills in customer engagement, inside sales, and business development.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their updated resume:

**Email:** jay@upliftmitra.com

**UpliftMitra — Your Partner in Growth, Clarity and Calm.**

* **GSAM.com**: GSAM is the asset management arm of Goldman Sachs, which supervises more than $1.8 trillion in assets. Goldman Sachs Asset Management has been providing discretionary investment advisory services since 1988 and has investment professionals in all major financial centers around the world.

Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. **About Klipit.ai**

Klipit.ai is building technology solutions that help businesses streamline their HR, finance, accounting, and document management processes. Our enterprise product portfolio includes:

* **BizHR:** HRMS, employee management, attendance, payroll, and related HR operations.
* **Bizpro:** Invoice management, expense reimbursement, accounting automation, and integrations with accounting platforms such as Tally.
* **Bizvault:** Secure cloud storage and document management for businesses.

We are looking for a results-driven **Outbound Calling Manager** to lead our telecalling and lead qualification team, generate qualified sales meetings, and build a predictable pipeline of opportunities for our sales team.

**Role Overview**

The candidate will be responsible for managing a team of outbound callers who connect with prospective businesses, understand their requirements, qualify leads, and schedule high-quality product demonstrations and sales meetings.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong team management, outbound sales process expertise, performance monitoring, and the ability to deliver measurable results through disciplined execution.

The primary objective is not just to generate calls, but to convert prospecting efforts into qualified meetings and revenue opportunities for the sales team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Management & Leadership**

* Recruit, train, manage, and motivate a team of outbound callers and lead qualification executives.
* Set daily, weekly, and monthly targets for calls, qualified leads, meetings booked, and meetings attended.
* Conduct daily team huddles, performance reviews, call coaching, and periodic training sessions.
* Monitor individual productivity and take corrective action to improve performance.
* Build a target-oriented culture focused on meeting quality rather than call volumes alone.

**2. Outbound Calling & Lead Qualification**

* Develop and execute outbound calling strategies targeting SMEs, startups, distributors, manufacturers, and other relevant businesses.
* Ensure callers effectively communicate the value propositions of BizHR, Bizpro, and Bizvault.
* Qualify prospects based on company size, employee strength, business requirements, existing software, decision-maker access, and purchase intent.
* Identify the appropriate decision-makers, including business owners, CFOs, finance heads, HR managers, and operations heads.
* Schedule qualified product demos and sales meetings for the enterprise sales team.
* Ensure accurate lead information, qualification notes, meeting confirmations, and follow-up records are maintained in the CRM.

**3. Sales Pipeline & Meeting Management**

* Work closely with the sales team to understand the ideal customer profile and improve meeting quality.
* Ensure scheduled meetings meet agreed qualification criteria and are relevant to the assigned salesperson.
* Track meetings booked, meetings attended, cancellations, no-shows, and conversions into opportunities.
* Coordinate with sales executives to collect feedback on lead quality and continuously improve qualification standards.
* Implement follow-up processes to minimise meeting drop-offs and maximise attendance.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified meetings to support monthly customer acquisition targets.

**4. Data Management & Performance Reporting**

* Monitor daily calling activity, connect rates, conversations, lead qualification rates, and meeting conversion rates.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for management.
* Analyse campaign performance, lead sources, calling scripts, and team productivity.
* Work with the marketing team to improve lead quality and optimise campaign outcomes.
* Maintain clean, accurate, and updated CRM records and ensure disciplined follow-up.

**5. Process Improvement**

* Develop effective calling scripts, objection-handling frameworks, and qualification checklists.
* Design separate calling approaches for HR, finance, accounting automation, and document management prospects.
* Introduce structured training and quality monitoring processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity through better data, segmentation, automation, and calling practices.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4 years of experience in outbound telecalling, inside sales, lead generation, or sales development.
* At least 2 years of experience managing and achieving targets through a team of callers or lead qualification executives.
* Proven track record of generating qualified B2B meetings for field sales, inside sales, or enterprise sales teams.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, HRMS, accounting software, fintech, ERP, or other business technology solutions is preferred.
* Strong people management, coaching, communication, and objection-handling skills.
* Ability to analyse performance metrics and take data-driven decisions.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, Excel/Google Sheets, and telecalling tools.
* Strong organisational skills and a target-driven mindset.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be measured against business outcomes, including:

* Number of qualified meetings scheduled per month.
* Percentage of scheduled meetings successfully attended.
* Percentage of meetings accepted by the sales team as qualified.
* Lead-to-meeting conversion rate.
* Meeting-to-opportunity and meeting-to-customer conversion rates.
* Team productivity and achievement of monthly targets.
* Accuracy of CRM data and follow-up discipline.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

title: Manager, Applied Science, Minerva
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for an Applied Science Manager to build and lead Minerva's first Risk Science team in Bengaluru. This is a hands-on role: you will collaborate with scientists in the US to set the scientific bar and advance how we detect and respond to risk across KDP and Kindle Unlimited.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of applied scientists across levels, and set its practices for experimentation, evaluation, reviews, publishing, and patents.

  

* Push the quality of production risk models higher: set the standard for how model performance is measured, and lead the deep-dive science that turns model behavior into better detection.

  

* Develop new and improved detection models for fraud, abuse, copyright infringement, and harmful content, using NLP, computer vision, LLMs, and behavioral and graph-based modeling.

  

* Partner with engineering, product, policy, and investigation teams in the US and India to turn findings into fixes, and present options, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leaders.

  

* Work with the US science team to divide ownership clearly and share methods across Minerva.

  
About the team  
Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) has empowered a new wave of self-motivated creators, tearing down barriers that once blocked writers from reaching readers. Minerva is the science and analytics organization for Amazon's Books business. We build systems for content understanding, author marketing and discovery, fraud and abuse prevention, and content risk, and we optimize manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality for Print On Demand (POD). We have mature areas and green-field opportunities, with engineering, business intelligence, and data engineering support across our areas. We are now building science teams in Bengaluru that work closely with our scientists in the US. Risk Science, a team within Minerva, keeps fraud, abuse, copyright infringement, and harmful content out of the Books catalog and programs such as Kindle Unlimited, using text, image, and behavioral data.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
* Excellent communication skills, capable of discussing technical details with a variety of audiences and influencing decision-making processes.
* Experience writing, reviewing, and testing production code in Python or a related language
* Experience shipping machine learning, NLP, or computer vision models to production and maintaining their quality after launch

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience leading teams in the areas of fraud detection, abuse prevention, and content risk management within a digital or e-commerce environment.
* Experience with model monitoring, data drift detection, calibration, or causal analysis of model behavior
* Experience with graph-based ML, behavioral modeling, or real-time detection
* Experience with LLMs, fine-tuning, embeddings, or multimodal models
* Experience building a new team, including hiring across several levels
* PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related quantitative field, or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed venues (for example KDD, NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, CVPR) or patents
* Experience leading teams that build with AI coding agents, with guardrails such as tests, automated review, and verifiable done criteria

**Performance Marketing Associate**
===================================

Function: Performance Marketing
  
Location: Bengaluru (HSR Layout)
  
Experience: 1–3 years
  
Company: AppsForBharat – Sri Mandir

**About AppsForBharat**
-----------------------

AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir App) is building beautifully crafted, AI-first consumer experiences that help millions of Indians connect with spirituality and culture. We’re backed by Peak XV Partners, Elevation, Fundamentum, and other top-tier investors, and are one of India’s fastest-growing Series C consumer-tech companies.

Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, is the world’s largest platform for Hindu devotees, powering rituals, teachings, personalized recommendations, and a thriving devotional community. India’s $44B devotion economy is still largely offline, and we’re bringing structure, accessibility, and meaning to this massive market, where design and data play a central role in shaping user behavior at scale.

  
  

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a results-driven Performance Marketing Associate to manage and scale paid marketing campaigns while driving core business metrics such as revenue, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and contribution margins.

This role requires hands-on campaign execution, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to connect marketing performance with business outcomes. You will work closely with category, creative, content, CRM, and product teams to identify growth opportunities and improve acquisition efficiency.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**1. Campaign Execution & Growth**

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimise paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant digital platforms.
* Own campaign execution end-to-end, from planning and setup to monitoring, optimisation, and reporting.
* Scale campaigns while maintaining efficiency across key metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, and contribution margins.

**2. Performance Analytics & Business Impact**

* Track campaign-level metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS, and connect them to business outcomes such as revenue, CM1, CM2, and baseline contribution.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) to understand performance fluctuations and identify actionable growth opportunities.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting structures to monitor campaign and business performance.

**3. Optimisation & Experimentation**

* Run experiments across creatives, audiences, landing pages, and campaign strategies.
* Partner with creative and content teams to develop and test performance-driven creatives and messaging.
* Explore new channels, formats, and growth opportunities to improve campaign performance.

**4. Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work with category teams to align campaigns with the puja calendar, seasonal demand, and product launches.
* Collaborate with CRM, product, content, and influencer teams to drive growth across channels.
* Contribute to branding and performance initiatives that improve overall business performance.

  

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, with evidence of campaign optimisation and growth.
* Practical experience with paid media platforms, particularly Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect campaign metrics with business outcomes.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting, analysis, and performance tracking.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and an ownership-driven approach.
* Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience managing and scaling medium-to-large marketing budgets efficiently.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, Looker Studio, or similar analytics and reporting tools.
* Experience in a fast-paced, growth-oriented consumer business.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Work on a consumer platform serving millions of devotees.
* Take ownership of meaningful growth metrics beyond campaign-level performance.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve real business problems and build scalable growth initiatives.

**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys**

title: Senior Data Partnerships Manager I
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on technical customer success leader to be the go-to expert for Nielsen’s newest data products: Audience Builder, Data Driven Linear (DDL), data clean rooms, API-based offerings such as N1 advanced audiences, and the Media Data Engine (MDE).

Working from Bengaluru with clients and colleagues in the US, you will design how clients connect to our data, build the APIs, clean rooms and scripts that make it work, and help them get measurable value from it. You will also co-lead Quality 2.0, a program with Engineering that tracks data quality by its impact on customers, not just delivery metrics.

Responsibilities

Technical solutions and client integrations

* Lead technical discussions with client data, engineering and analytics teams, and design integrations that fit each client's systems.
* Set up and troubleshoot REST and GraphQL API integrations, including authentication, paging, rate limits and error handling.
* Configure and query data clean rooms (for example Snowflake, Databricks), and support audience matching and overlap analysis.
* Write production-quality SQL and Python scripts and reusable code samples that speed up client onboarding.
* Run in-depth technical training for internal teams and client technical staff.

Product expertise and adoption

* Become the expert on a portfolio of audience and measurement data products, including their data models, APIs and main client use cases.
* Support audience workflows that combine first-party, third-party and Nielsen data, and help clients activate audiences in downstream platforms through the UI, APIs and AI-agent connections.
* Help media sellers, agencies and ad tech platforms use measurement data through APIs for planning, pacing, forecasting and deal reconciliation.
* Lead onboarding and adoption for new API-based data products. Deliver tailored training, define best practices, track usage, and turn client feedback into product improvements.

Data quality and customer impact (co-lead with Engineering)

* Build and maintain a quality scorecard that combines delivery metrics, customer impact and customer feedback.
* Analyse escalation trends and customer feedback to find recurring issues and their root causes.
* Push for preventive controls, such as automated data-freshness monitoring, more reliable reprocessing, and contract tests before each release, to reduce quality issues reported by customers.

Customer success and advocacy

* Lead onboarding for new clients, with demos, training and learning materials tailored to their needs.
* Track customer health and adoption metrics, and run plans to grow usage and retention.
* Represent the client inside Nielsen, sharing their needs and market trends with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales.
* Resolve complex client issues quickly by working with internal teams across time zones.

 **Qualifications**

What you will bring

Must have

* 5+ years of experience, including at least 4 years in a client-facing technical role such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Implementation or Data Consultant, or Technical Customer Success.
* Advanced SQL (CTEs, window functions, performance tuning) on a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks.
* At least 2 years of hands-on Python for data work and automation (pandas, requests, scripting).
* Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs (Postman, OAuth/API keys, JSON, troubleshooting) and GraphQL APIs.
* Experience working directly with US or other global clients, including presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Data clean rooms: Snowflake Data Clean Rooms, LiveRamp Habu, AWS Clean Rooms or Google Ads Data Hub.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
* AWS & Data pipelines and quality tools: Airflow, dbt, redshift, monitoring and alerting.

Good to have

* Media, ad tech or measurement: TV/CTV, GRPs/impressions, audience-based buying, programmatic (DSP/SSP), post-buy reconciliation.
* AI and agent tools: LLM APIs, MCP or similar agent integrations.
* BI tools (Tableau,powerbi) and work-tracking tools (Jira, ServiceNow, Salesforce).

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.
