title: Growth Lead
description:
**About Us**
  

  

Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life\-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru\-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future.
  

  

Today, 20 million\+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.
  

  

We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way.
  

  

Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million\+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
  

  

And this is just the beginning!
  

  

**What’s the role?**
  

  

Jar's gold savings business is the core of the company. It serves first\-time digital savers, largely outside the metros, and it moves real money every day. We are looking for a Growth Lead to own it end to end.
  

  

This is a P\&L\-shaped role rather than a channel\-shaped one. You will own gold GMV and every input that produces it: activating new savers, increasing the frequency and ticket size of existing ones, retaining them, winning back the ones who have gone quiet, and expanding them into adjacent products. The measure of success is a durable change in the slope of the business, not a good quarter.
  

  

The distinction that matters most to us is how you get there. We are looking for someone who drives growth primarily through product, and uses campaigns, lifecycle and comms to amplify what the product has already earned. Teams that lean on discounting and notification volume can hold a number for a quarter. They cannot compound. You will have a cross\-functional pod of product managers, growth managers, analysts and lifecycle owners to do this properly, and you will own the roadmap that directs them.
  

  

You will report to the VP of Growth who currently holds this scope alongside Jar's jewellery vertical and new business lines. You will be reviewed on the business and its narrative, not on individual projects.

  

  

**What will be your responsibilities?**  

  



*Own the GMV equation*


* Decompose gold GMV into its constituent inputs and maintain a clear point of view on which input is binding in any given quarter.
* Set the roadmap and sequencing across activation, frequency, retention, win\-back and cross\-sell, and defend the trade\-offs between them.
* Carry the number. Report performance and the reasoning behind it directly to leadership.
  


  

*Grow revenue per user*


* Increase transaction frequency and ticket size through changes to the saving experience: habit loops, goals, streaks, visible progress, and the moments that bring a user back unprompted.
* Identify and close leakage across the transactional spine \- accumulation flows, autopay, withdrawals and liquidation, pricing, rewards and refunds.
* Build the cross\-sell and upsell path into Jar's wider surface without cannibalising core saving behaviour.
  


  

*Retain and win back*


* Own retention as a product problem. Diagnose why cohorts decay and fix the reasons, rather than managing the symptom through lifecycle messaging.
* Segment dormant and churned users by cause of departure and build differentiated win\-back paths for each.
  


  

*Drive experimentation*


* Design and run a high\-throughput experiment programme with clear hypotheses, adequate power, and honest read\-outs.
* Make kill decisions quickly and document what was learned. Protect the team from shipping things that tested flat.
  


  

*Lead the pod*


* Manage and grow a cross\-functional team of product managers, growth managers, analysts and lifecycle owners.
* Set the hiring bar for your team and make the selection calls.
* Work closely with engineering, design, data and marketing to get work shipped on pace.
  


  

*Operate the business*


* Maintain the instrumentation and dashboards needed to know the state of the business without being told.
* Respond to breakages in a live money product with appropriate urgency, and close the detection gaps that allowed them to go unnoticed.
  

  

**What’s required from you?**  

  



* 7\+ years in consumer growth, product or monetisation roles, including at least 2 years managing a team or a pod.
* Demonstrable ownership of a revenue or GMV number, with the ability to speak precisely about what you moved and how.
* A track record of product\-led growth. You should be able to walk through a product change you shipped that durably moved a retention or frequency metric, and explain why it worked.
* Strong quantitative foundation. SQL fluency is expected and not delegated. Comfort with cohort analysis, funnel instrumentation and experiment design.
* Experience in consumer fintech, commerce, mobility, or on\-demand at scale in India. Exposure to Tier 2 and Tier 3 users is a significant advantage; instincts built on metro\-affluent products do not transfer cleanly.
* Bachelor's in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline from a reputed institute, or an MBA from a reputed institute.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and limited supervision. This role assumes you will find your own problems.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You will be explaining the business to leadership and to your team on a weekly cadence.
* Working knowledge of analytics and lifecycle tooling (Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, Data Studio or equivalent).
  

  

**What makes us different?**
  

  

We’re not just building a product—we’re shaping the future of savings in India. We seek people who bring passion, energy, and fresh ideas to help us make that happen. Experience matters, but we are a potential first organisation. We move fast, learn from our mistakes, and take bold risks to solve problems that haven’t been attempted before. If you’re excited about working in an environment where people inspire and truly support each other, you’ve found the right fit.
  

  

**What do we stand for?**
  

  

The five values that we live by :
  

  

**Passion:** At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work.
  

**Equality:** We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves.
  

**Growth:** When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact.
  

**Accountability:** The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions.
  

**Consistency:** We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time.
  

  

Join us and let’s build something amazing together!
  

  

**What employee benefits do we have?**
  

  

Glad you asked! Among other things, we have


* Medical Insurance for employees and their families
* ESOPs allocation
* Pluxee meal card
* Swish club card for exclusive employee discounts
* Advance salary plans
* Relocation assistance
* L\&D programmes

title: Events Marketing Manager
description:
**About Juspay**
================



Juspay is a leading multinational payments technology company, powering superior conversion rates, seamless customer experiences, cost optimization, and fraud reduction at scale for 500\+ top global enterprises and banks. Founded in 2012, the company processes over 300 million daily transactions, exceeding an annualized total payment volume (TPV) of $1 trillion with 99\.999% reliability. Headquartered in Bangalore, India, Juspay’s global network of 1200\+ payment experts operates across San Francisco, Dublin, São Paulo, and Singapore.



Juspay offers a modular and interoperable product suite for merchants that includes open\-source payment orchestration, seamless authentication, payment tokenization, fraud \& risk management, global payouts, end\-to\-end reconciliation, unified payment analytics, and more. For banks, Juspay’s offerings include end\-to\-end white label payment gateway solutions \& real\-time payments infrastructure.



\*\*  

About the Role\*\*



Payments is a relationship business, and events are where Juspay earns a seat at the table with the CXOs, product leaders, and engineering teams who decide how the world’s largest merchants and banks move money. We’re looking for an Events Marketing Manager to own that surface end\-to\-end — from flagship industry conferences and proprietary Juspay events to regional roadshows and partner co\-marketing activations.



This is a “day 1” ownership role, not a checklist job. You’ll be trusted to set the events strategy, not just execute a calendar handed to you — deciding which stages Juspay should be on, what story we tell there, and how we prove it moved the pipeline.



\*\*  

What You’ll Do\*\*


* Own the end\-to\-end events calendar and strategy — flagship industry conferences (e.g. Global Fintech Fest, Money20/20, industry payments summits), Juspay\-hosted events, partner/bank co\-marketing activations, and regional roadshows across our key markets.


* Lead planning and execution for each event: budgeting, vendor and venue negotiation, booth/stage design coordination with creative teams, logistics, staffing, and on\-ground run of show.


* Partner with Sales, Product, and Leadership to define event goals, target account lists, speaking topics, and messaging — and to prep spokespeople and booth staff.


* Manage pre\-event demand generation (invites, landing pages, email sequences) and post\-event follow\-up in coordination with the growth/demand\-gen team, ensuring leads are captured, qualified, and routed without leakage.


* Own sponsorship strategy: evaluate inbound and outbound sponsorship opportunities, negotiate packages, and track deliverables against contracts.


* Track and report on event ROI — pipeline sourced/influenced, cost per lead/meeting, and brand impact — and use that data to continuously reprioritize the calendar.


* Coordinate speaking submissions, award nominations, and media/analyst interactions tied to events, working closely with PR and Content Marketing.


* Manage relationships with external vendors, agencies, and production partners; build a playbook that makes each subsequent event faster and cheaper to run.


* Travel to on\-ground events as needed (domestic and international) to run execution personally.


**Must\-Have Qualities**


* 3\+ years of experience in B2B events marketing, field marketing, or experiential marketing


* Comfort negotiating with vendors, venues, and sponsors, and managing a budget with real accountability for ROI.


* Sharp project management instincts — juggling multiple events in flight, with dozens of moving parts and stakeholders, without dropping details.


* Ease of working cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Design, and Leadership; you can pull a room together and keep it aligned under deadline pressure.


* Excellent written and verbal communication,


* Willingness to travel for on\-site execution.

title: VP, Investment Allocations
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1\.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Job Summary and Business Unit Overview**


Blackstone Credit \& Insurance (BXCI) was created in September 2023 by combining Blackstone's Credit and Insurance businesses. BXCI offers a broad range of solutions across corporate and asset\-based credit, including investment\-grade and non\-investment\-grade private credit. BXCI invests across the credit markets and manages strategies focused on sectors with strong fundamentals.


We are seeking a highly motivated Vice President to lead the Investment Allocations team within BXCI. The role will oversee the Bengaluru Center of Excellence (CoE) team and partner closely with global Investment Allocations stakeholders. The Vice President will be responsible for allocation governance, operational execution, controls, data quality, team leadership, and strategic transformation. The role requires sound judgment, strong execution discipline, and the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders across Investments, Capital Formation, Insurance, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal and Compliance, and Data teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Bengaluru Investment Allocations CoE and establish clear objectives, service standards, capacity plans, and accountability across the team.
* Partner with global colleagues to run hypothetical allocation scenarios (hypos), evaluate allocation outcomes, and support the timely and accurate finalization of allocations across asset classes, funds, and client mandates.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end allocation process, including data intake, eligibility validation, constraint monitoring, exception management, approvals, booking support, and post\-allocation review.
* Ensure allocations are executed in accordance with approved policies, investment guidelines, client and fund restrictions, conflicts protocols, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish and maintain robust governance, including maker\-checker controls, documented approvals, audit trails, escalation protocols, and periodic control attestations.
* Define, monitor, and report key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), service\-level metrics, and operational trends; drive timely remediation of identified issues.
* Perform and oversee periodic allocation surveillance, portfolio reviews, and management reporting for relevant business and client stakeholders.
* Drive consistent data quality and reconcile allocation inputs and outputs across source systems, models, and downstream records; ensure exceptions are investigated and resolved promptly.
* Act as the senior point of contact across business, Technology, Finance, Operations, Data, Legal and Compliance, Capital Formation, and Insurance teams globally.
* Lead strategic initiatives focused on modernization, workflow digitization, automation, standardization, and operational scalability.
* Assess change impacts, define business requirements, coordinate user acceptance testing, and ensure effective implementation and post\-go\-live stabilization of new processes and systems.
* Create effective handover and follow\-the\-sun operating models between regional teams, supported by clear procedures, business continuity plans, and cross\-training.
* Build, coach, and retain a high\-performing team through structured development plans, timely feedback, succession planning, and an inclusive culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* Prepare concise, executive\-level updates on performance, capacity, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and strategic outcomes.
* Respond to ad hoc requests from Investment, Capital Formation, Insurance, and other stakeholders, providing accurate and timely analysis.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory inquiries, and risk or compliance reviews by maintaining complete and readily retrievable evidence.


Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong knowledge of investment allocation processes, portfolio management operations, private credit, fund structures, and investment guideline monitoring.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing managers or senior individual contributors in a global or CoE operating model.
* Strong control mindset with experience in operational risk, governance, issue management, root\-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, identify patterns, and make sound decisions under time pressure.
* Ability to understand the broader business context while maintaining close attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex matters succinctly.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, multiple projects, and demanding deadlines with limited guidance.
* Strong relationship\-building skills and the ability to work seamlessly across functions and geographical locations.
* Experience driving process optimization, automation, technology implementation, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* High standards of integrity, accountability, professional judgment, and commitment to excellence.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly advanced Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with data visualization, workflow, or analytics tools is preferred.


Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline. A Chartered Accountant qualification, CFA, CPA, or MBA in Finance is preferred.
* 10 \+ years of relevant experience in investment management, private credit, asset management operations, a Big Four firm, or a global financial services organization.
* Prior experience in investment allocations, portfolio operations, guideline monitoring, or a related investment control function is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of direct lending, private credit, insurance mandates, and multi\-fund allocation frameworks is advantageous.
* Experience leading a distributed team and partnering with stakeholders in North America or other global locations is preferred.

  

The duties and responsibilities described here are not exhaustive and additional assignments, duties, or responsibilities may be required of this position. Assignments, duties, and responsibilities may be changed at any time, with or without notice, by Blackstone in its sole discretion.

Depending on the position, you may be required to obtain certain securities licenses if you are in a client facing role and/or if you are engaged in the following:

Your new role
  
In this role, you will develop and execute commercial device strategy and priorities across both International Operations (IO) and Global, with your time split equally between the two. You will independently drive projects related to device marketing, branding, product launch excellence and lifecycle management activities – bringing commercial guidance to device development across therapy areas and working with stakeholders at every level of the organisation.

Independently driving commercial deliverables as part of the claims process, including identifying target claims, conducting cross\-functional processes and providing input across therapy areas
  
Leading developmental projects including business case development and evaluations with multiple stakeholders
  
Supporting governance, readiness tracking and stakeholder alignment for device launches by identifying risks, enabling decision\-making and driving completion of key launch deliverables

You will be based in our P\&PS GBS office in Bangalore, working across Device Strategy \& Marketing (Global) and Portfolio \& Launch Strategy (IO). This is a highly cross\-functional role where you will engage with senior stakeholders across headquarters and international operations – from Vice Presidents and Senior Directors to Global Product Managers and R\&D teams – to ensure our device portfolio reaches patients effectively in markets around the world.
  
  

Your skills \& qualifications
  
  

We are looking for someone who thrives in a complex, fast\-moving environment and can independently set direction while bringing others along. You will bring:
  
  

10\+ years of experience in pharmaceutical marketing, medical affairs, sales, brand management or project management – experience within the diabetes therapy area is preferred

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence at senior levels across a matrixed organisation

title: Senior Revenue Operations & AI Adoption Executive
description:
### **Job Information**

### **Job Description**


Who We Are:

  

Increff is the most preferred retail SaaS partner, solving complex inventory management and supply chain challenges for retailers seeking to revolutionize their supply chains both technologically and operationally.

  

What We Offer:

  

Our core focus is on providing innovative retail tech solutions, including merchandising and omni channel inventory management. These solutions are meticulously designed to cater to the specific needs of brands and retailers, empowering them to thrive in the dynamic marketplace Innovative technology, comprehensive support, and a dynamic environment for career growth.

  

Our Vision:

  

To be the most admired retail technology company.

  

Job Summary:

  

As a Senior Revenue Operations \& AI Adoption Executive, you'll own the systems, data, and automation that connect Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with architectural ownership: you will design the CRM data model, lead revenue analytics and forecasting, build the automation and AI infrastructure the GTM org runs on, and set the operating standards other RevOps executives and GTM teams follow.

  

This is also a builder role, ideal for someone who enjoys owning systems end\-to\-end, designing scalable processes, and working directly with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable systems.

  

Responsibilities:

  

1\. Revenue Operations Strategy \& GTM Analytics

* Own end\-to\-end revenue reporting: pipeline, MRR, expected MRR, conversion, stage movement, forecasting, and revenue performance
* Build and continuously evolve management dashboards and recurring weekly/monthly revenue reporting for leadership
* Maintain pipeline and revenue snapshots to enable historical trend analysis and forecasting accuracy
* Lead ad\-hoc analysis and data\-driven input for business reviews, board decks, and leadership decision\-making
* Set the reporting and metrics framework (definitions, cadences, ownership) that the entire S\&M team follows

  

2\. CRM Architecture, Data Governance \& Salesforce Administration

* Own Salesforce configuration end\-to\-end: custom objects, fields, Flows, validation rules, sharing model, and Experience Cloud access
* Define and enforce data governance standards across Leads, Accounts, Contacts, and Opportunities
* Design multi\-track lead qualification frameworks (e.g. product\-line\-specific tracks), BANT structures, and auto\-population logic
* Diagnose and resolve complex production issues (record\-locking flows, trigger bugs, sharing/ownership conflicts) with root\-cause investigation
* Author CRM SOPs and process documentation that scale as the GTM org grows

  

3\. Revenue Automation \& AI\-Driven Systems

* Architect the revenue automation stack — intent/visitor data, contact enrichment, email sequencing, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Factors.ai, Apollo/Seamless, Salesforce, n8n, Make)
* Build integrations across CRM, communication, productivity, and GTM systems to create connected, end\-to\-end workflows
* Design AI\-assisted processes that convert unstructured inputs (emails, meeting notes, internal chat) into structured CRM and revenue data
* Evaluate and maintain the entire S\&M tech stack, building custom MCP/API connectors where needed to enable AI\-assisted workflows
* Build lightweight internal tools or agents where off\-the\-shelf software doesn't solve the problem

  

4\. Pipeline \& Forecast Ownership

* Own monthly pipeline and revenue forecast accuracy, including coverage\-vs\-target analysis
* Build and maintain deal/pipeline health scoring (risk flags, weighted scoring, stage\-based alerts) for rep\- and manager\-level visibility
* Identify forecast risk early and communicate gaps to Sales leadership with supporting data
* Run pipeline hygiene audits — stale\-deal and stale\-lead identification using activity\-based (not just date\-based) criteria
* Support Monthly/Quarterly Business Reviews with accurate, defensible revenue and pipeline narratives

  

5\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& GTM Intelligence

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to design cross\-functional workflows (deal approvals, commercial reviews, customer hand\-offs)
* Build structured intake/ticketing processes for revenue\-related requests with clear SLAs and ownership
* Own competitive intelligence and account/GTM research frameworks that drive outbound and demand\-gen prioritization
* Mentor and set standards for other RevOps Executives, reviewing their CRM builds, reports, and automations
* Continuously identify and prioritize process redesigns that scale with GTM headcount growth

### **Requirements**


Who Should Apply:

  

This role is ideal for candidates with 2\-3 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Analytics, with demonstrated ownership of a CRM instance end\-to\-end.

  

Required Skills:

* 2\-3 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Analytics, with demonstrated ownership of a CRM instance end\-to\-end
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce administration expertise: Flows, validation rules, sharing/security model, custom objects, Experience Cloud
* Proven experience designing and operating automation/integration workflows (n8n, Make, or equivalent) or AI tools (Claude, OpenAI etc) across multiple systems
* Strong quantitative fluency in revenue/SaaS metrics (MRR, pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting) and advanced spreadsheet modeling
* Excellent written communication for leadership reporting, SOPs, and cross\-functional alignment, with a track record of translating ambiguous business problems into scalable systems

  

Nice to Have:

* Experience with AI/LLM\-assisted workflow design (agentic automation, structured data extraction from unstructured text)
* Background in B2B SaaS, supply chain, or retail\-tech GTM
* Experience building GTM strategy for new market segments or regulatory\-driven opportunities
* Familiarity with MCP/API connector setup for AI\-assisted tooling

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.


Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. **Company Description**  

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.


We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.


For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).


‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency


Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description** **Job Summary**  

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Manger” for driving the sales strategy and achieving business goals within your designated region, for executing the product management team's strategies, gathering customer feedback, and providing crucial insights for the development of new products. Your key focus will be on establishing and nurturing relationships with key opinion leaders, monitoring competitor information, and understanding prescription trends within the pharmaceutical industry. Additionally, you will be responsible for organizing and managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) events and other initiatives to bolster the company's brand image.  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for the promotion of the new product. You will be executing the Product Management Team’s marketing strategy, analysing market trends, consulting with doctors on new product potential, and relaying feedback to the Product Management Team. Additionally, responsibilities include identifying key opinion leaders, monitoring product availability, and implementing brand strategies to facilitate a successful product launch.
* You will be responsible for monitoring primary and secondary sales through regular visits to stockists and pharmacies, ensuring the accomplishment of doctor and product\-specific sales objectives. Active participation in monthly review meetings to assess coverage, adherence to SOPs, and expense management, all aimed at achieving area\-level, product\-level, and overall sales targets.
* You will be responsible for focusing on customer relationship management, the role entails establishing strong connections and addressing queries promptly using Infoginip. It also involves customer classification based on potential, determining meeting frequency accordingly, and tracking return on investment per customer to foster a loyal customer base for the company.
* You will responsible to meet Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Key business leader (KEL) frequently and pursue them to conduct CME with the company; Collect interest areas of key customers and hospitals and conduct CMEs on those topics.
* You will responsible to prepare product matrix depending upon doctor's potential \& preference and decide which product will fit doctor's need. Update data on chemist, doctors and Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) through palm top to Unnati portal in order to ensure all stakeholders' access to latest information.
 **Qualifications** **Educational qualification\-** Graduate with science background.  

  

**Minimum work experience\-** 6 months of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  

  

**Skills \& attributes**  

**Technical Skills**  

* Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.


  

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong Decision making skills.
 **Additional Information** **About the Department**  

**Global Generics India**  

Global Generics India business journey began in 1986\. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022\). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast\-growing organisation with double\-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti\-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  

  

**Benefits Offered**  

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  

  

**Our Work Culture**  

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.  

For more details, please visit our career website at **https://careers.drreddys.com/\#!/**

description:
Showroom Store Manager

**Panda Pedals \| EV Scooters \| Bangalore**

Panda Pedals is looking for a confident and responsible **Showroom Store Manager** who can take complete ownership of the day\-to\-day operations and sales performance of our electric scooter showroom.

This is not just a store supervision role.

We’re looking for someone who can manage customers, drive sales, follow up with leads, coordinate test rides and ensure every person walking into the showroom gets a great buying experience.

Your goal is simple:

**Run the showroom well and sell more scooters.**

What You’ll Do

* Manage the complete day\-to\-day operations of the showroom
* Attend to walk\-in customers and understand their requirements
* Explain Panda Pedals scooters, features, pricing and benefits clearly
* Conduct and coordinate test rides
* Convert showroom enquiries into sales
* Follow up with customers who have visited, enquired or taken a test ride
* Manage incoming leads from phone calls, WhatsApp, Google, website and marketing campaigns
* Maintain proper records of leads, follow\-ups and sales
* Coordinate scooter bookings, payments and deliveries
* Ensure scooters are displayed properly and the showroom is always presentable
* Maintain basic stock and inventory records
* Coordinate with the service and operations team when required
* Handle basic customer queries before and after purchase
* Ensure customers receive a smooth experience from enquiry to delivery
* Track daily and monthly sales performance
* Share regular updates with management

Sales Is a Major Part of This Role

We are looking for someone who is comfortable speaking with customers and closing sales.

You should be able to understand what the customer actually needs, explain the right scooter confidently and guide them towards making a purchase decision.

You should also be comfortable following up.

Many customers will not buy on their first visit.

Your ability to stay in touch, answer their questions and bring them back to the showroom will be an important part of the role.

What We’re Looking For

You should be:

* Confident and well\-spoken
* Comfortable dealing with customers face\-to\-face
* Good at sales and negotiation
* Comfortable following up on phone and WhatsApp
* Organised with leads and customer records
* Responsible and able to manage the showroom independently
* Presentable and professional
* Target\-oriented
* Comfortable working with daily and monthly sales goals
* Able to handle customer objections calmly
* Good at building trust with customers

You’ll Be a Strong Fit If

You enjoy talking to customers.

You can explain products without sounding scripted.

You know when to push for a sale and when to give the customer space.

You follow up consistently instead of waiting for customers to call back.

You take ownership of the showroom instead of waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

And when showroom sales are slow, your first thought is:

**“What can I do today to bring more customers back and close more deals?”**

Key ResponsibilitiesCustomer Experience

Ensure every customer entering the showroom is attended to properly and receives clear information about the scooters.

Lead Management

Track every enquiry and ensure there is a proper follow\-up until the customer buys or clearly declines.

Test Rides

Encourage interested customers to take test rides and ensure the experience is smooth and professional.

Sales

Work towards individual and showroom\-level monthly sales targets.

Showroom Management

Maintain cleanliness, scooter display, marketing material and overall presentation of the showroom.

Inventory

Keep track of available scooters, colours, variants and delivery\-ready vehicles.

Delivery Coordination

Ensure customers receive the correct vehicle and have a smooth handover experience.

What Your Performance Will Be Measured On

* Number of showroom walk\-ins handled
* Test rides conducted
* Lead follow\-up rate
* Walk\-in to test ride conversion
* Test ride to sale conversion
* Monthly scooter sales
* Lead response time
* Customer experience
* Showroom discipline and presentation

The objective is not simply to keep the showroom running.

The objective is to **make the showroom perform.**

Experience

**2 to 5 years preferred**

Previous experience in any of the following is an advantage:

* Automobile showroom sales
* Two\-wheeler sales
* EV sales
* Retail store management
* Automotive dealership
* Consumer electronics sales
* High\-value retail sales

Experience in the automobile industry is preferred, but strong sales ability and customer\-handling skills are more important.

Languages

Comfortable speaking in:

* English
* Kannada
* Hindi

Additional languages are an advantage.

Apply

description:
**Designation Manager – Early Childhood Development \& Curriculum**

**Location: Domlur, Bengaluru**

**Level: Manager / Department Lead**

**About the Role** 

Zoodle Kid is looking for an experienced Early Childhood Development \& Curriculum Manager to lead the academic and developmental integrity of our programs for children aged 0–6 years. We are not looking for someone whose expertise is limited to curriculum writing or academic content. This role requires a professional with a deep understanding of Early Childhood Development (ECD), Early Childhood Education (ECE), pedagogy, developmental milestones, child psychology, age\-appropriate learning, and play\-based development along with the leadership maturity to translate that knowledge into high\-quality programs and a capable curriculum team. The person will take ownership of curriculum development, validation, research, team training, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement across Zoodle Kid's programs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1\. Early Childhood Development \& Pedagogy

* Bring strong subject expertise in child development from birth to 6 years.
* Understand developmental milestones across cognitive, language, physical, social, emotional, behavioural, and creative domains.
* Ensure activities and learning experiences are developmentally appropriate for each age group.
* Apply sound principles of ECE, pedagogy, child psychology, play\-based learning, and experiential learning.
* Translate developmental concepts and research into practical experiences parents can conduct with children at home.
* Understand individual developmental differences and avoid a one\-size\-fits\-all approach to childhood development.

2\. Curriculum Leadership

* Lead the research, development, refinement, and continuous improvement of Zoodle Kid's age\-wise curriculum.
* Ensure strong progression and continuity across 0–6 months, 6–12 months, 1–2, 2–3, 3–4, and 4–6 years. Ensure activities have clear developmental objectives rather than being included merely for engagement.
* Maintain alignment between activities, developmental milestones, learning outcomes, materials, and Zoodle Kid's 9Q framework.
* Identify curriculum gaps, redundancies, developmental mismatches, and opportunities for improvement.

3\. Validation \& Quality Assurance

* A major responsibility of this position is the ability to identify what is wrong, understand why it is wrong, and determine how it should be corrected.
* Validate curriculum documents, activity guides, scripts, learning materials, program videos, and parent\-facing content.
* Check for developmental appropriateness, factual accuracy, age suitability, safety, practicality, and pedagogical value.
* Identify errors or weak developmental reasoning before content reaches parents.
* Troubleshoot inconsistencies and provide clear corrective direction to the team.
* Establish validation checklists, standards, and review processes for curriculum quality.
* Coordinate expert/SME validation wherever specialist intervention is required.

4\. Research \& Development

* Continuously research developments in early childhood development, neuroscience, psychology, pedagogy, parenting, and learning sciences.
* Evaluate research critically rather than relying solely on trends or generic online information.
* Convert relevant research into practical, parent\-friendly learning experiences.
* Work with psychologists, pediatricians, therapists, educators, and other subject matter experts where necessary.
* Strengthen the scientific and developmental foundation behind Zoodle Kid's programs.

5\. Team Leadership \& Training

* Lead and mentor curriculum developers, associates, researchers, and related contributors.
* Train the team on ECD, developmental milestones, pedagogy, research methods, validation standards, and Zoodle Kid's framework.
* Be capable of explaining why something is developmentally right or wrong rather than simply approving or rejecting it.
* Conduct regular knowledge sessions, reviews, feedback discussions, and quality audits.
* Delegate effectively while maintaining accountability for final curriculum quality.
* Build a team capable of independently researching, questioning, validating, and improving content.

6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Video, Design, Product/Tech, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure accurate execution of curriculum.
* Translate curriculum requirements into clear instructions for non\-academic teams.
* Support Program Advisors and parent\-facing teams with developmental knowledge and training.
* Analyse recurring parent questions and feedback to identify opportunities for program improvement.

**Education Qualifications:**

* Master's degree preferred in one or more of the following: Early Childhood Education / Early Childhood Care \& Education Child Development / Human Development Developmental or Child Psychology Education / Pedagogy Psychology with strong ECD experience Developmental Sciences
* Other closely related disciplines Relevant professional certifications in ECE/ECCE, Montessori, developmental psychology, special education, or child development are an advantage.

**Experience** 

* Ideally 3\+ years of relevant experience, with meaningful exposure to early childhood development or education.
* Prior experience leading a curriculum, pedagogy, academic, ECD or program development team is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in curriculum design, review, validation, and team training. Experience working specifically with the 0–6 age group is highly desirable.
* Depth of expertise will be valued over years of experience alone.

*We Are Specifically Looking For*

We need someone who can look at an activity, curriculum document, or program video and confidently answer: **Is this right for this child's age?**  What developmental purpose does it serve? **Which milestone or developmental domain does it support?**  Is the underlying explanation scientifically and pedagogically sound? **Is it safe and realistic for a parent to execute?**  What is wrong with it, if anything? **How should we correct it?**  Can I teach my team to understand the same reasoning? If a candidate can consistently answer these questions with depth and clarity, they are likely the kind of professional we are looking for.

title: Planning Lead
description:
**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports \& Cine Optics.


ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R\&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales \& Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200\+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.


Further information at ZEISS India .


Role purpose
  

The Planning Manager leads end\-to\-end demand, supply, production and inventory planning for the Vision Care business. The role ensures reliable product availability, optimized inventory and efficient use of manufacturing and distribution capacity while balancing customer service, cost and working\-capital objectives.
  

Key responsibilities
  

1\. Sales and operations planning
  

* 

Lead the monthly S\&OP/IBP cycle across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Manufacturing, Procurement and Logistics.
  

* 

Consolidate demand, capacity, supply, inventory and financial plans.
  

* 

Identify gaps and scenarios and facilitate management decisions.
  

* 

Maintain one agreed operational plan and track actions from planning reviews.
  

* 

Translate annual business plans into monthly and weekly operational plans.
  

2\. Demand planning
  

* 

Lead statistical forecasting and market\-input collection for lenses, coatings, consumables and related products.
  

* 

Review historical sales, seasonality, promotions, launches, tenders and customer trends.
  

* 

Challenge assumptions and resolve differences between commercial forecasts and statistical demand.
  

* 

Manage forecast accuracy and bias by product family, channel and region.
  

* 

Establish planning approaches for new products, phase\-outs and intermittent demand.
  

3\. Supply and production/Import planning
  

* 

Develop feasible supply and production plans across Import/Local plants, laboratories, distribution centers and external suppliers.
  

* 

Balance demand against material, machine, labor and supplier capacity.
  

* 

Set production priorities and manage bottlenecks, shortages and backlog.
  

* 

Coordinate make\-to\-stock, make\-to\-order and prescription\-lens requirements.
  

* 

Ensure timely escalation of supply risks with clear recovery plans.
  

* 

Work with Procurement on supplier constraints, lead times and material availability.
  

4\. Inventory management
  

* 

Define inventory targets, safety stocks, reorder parameters and segmentation policies.
  

* 

Optimize inventory across raw materials, semi\-finished lenses, finished goods and consumables.
  

* 

Monitor ageing, slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
  

* 

Coordinate mitigation actions for excess stock and expiry or obsolescence risks.
  

* 

Improve working capital without compromising agreed service levels.
  

5\. Product lifecycle and launch planning
  

* 

Lead supply\-chain readiness for new products, coatings, technologies and portfolio changes.
  

* 

Coordinate demand ramp\-up, material availability, production validation and initial stock.
  

* 

Manage end\-of\-life transitions and depletion of discontinued materials.
  

* 

Minimize write\-offs and customer\-service disruption during portfolio transitions.
  

6\. Customer\-service and exception management
  

* 

Monitor fill rate, order fulfilment, backorders and delivery performance.
  

* 

Lead cross\-functional response to major shortages and demand changes.
  

* 

Prioritize constrained supply using agreed commercial and customer\-service rules.
  

* 

Communicate recovery dates, risks and alternatives to relevant stakeholders.
  

7\. Systems, data and process improvement
  

* 

Ensure accurate planning parameters and master data in SAP and associated planning tools.
  

* 

Drive planning automation, analytics and process standardization.
  

* 

Improve forecast models, planning horizons, frozen periods and exception\-management rules.
  

* 

Support ERP, APS, IBP and digital supply\-chain initiatives.
  

* 

Maintain planning documentation, controls and audit readiness.
  

8\. Team leadership
  

* 

Build analytical, commercial and supply\-chain capabilities within the team.
  

* 

Promote fact\-based decisions, accountability and cross\-functional collaboration.
  

* 

Establish succession and competency\-development plans.
  

Key performance indicators
  

* 

Forecast accuracy and forecast bias
  

* 

Customer service level, OTIF and fill rate
  

* 

Production\-plan adherence
  

* 

Inventory value, days of inventory and inventory turns
  

* 

Slow\-moving and obsolete inventory
  

* 

Backorder value and ageing
  

* 

Capacity utilization
  

* 

Planning master\-data accuracy
  

* 

S\&OP action closure and decision quality
  

* 

Working capital and logistics\-expedite/Diversion costs  

  

Qualifications
  

* 

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Operations, Engineering (STEM background mandatory).
  

* 

Master’s degree or MBA is advantageous.
  

* 

APICS CPIM/CSCP, IBF or equivalent certification is advantageous.
  

* 

Typically, 6\-8 years of supply\-chain experience, including at least 4 years in a planning role in handling complex SKU portfolio handling and assortment planning
  

* 

Experience in medical technology, optical products, healthcare, precision manufacturing or consumer goods is desirable.
  

Technical competencies
  

* 

Strong knowledge of demand, supply, production and inventory planning.
  

* 

Practical experience with S\&OP or IBP processes.
  

* 

Advanced SAP experience, ideally including SD, MM, PP and APO/IBP.
  

* 

Strong Excel and data\-analysis capabilities; Power BI or similar tools are advantageous.
  

* 

Understanding of MRP, capacity planning, safety stock and product lifecycle management.
  

* 

Ability to analyze complex product portfolios with short lead\-time and customized\-order requirements.
  

* 

Familiarity with Lean, continuous improvement and root\-cause analysis.
  

* 

Leadership and behavioral competencies
  

* 

Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills.
  

* 

Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  

* 

Clear communication and effective meeting facilitation.
  

* 

Customer\-focused and commercially aware decision\-making.
  

* 

Confidence in managing ambiguity, constraints and competing priorities.
  

* 

Strong people leadership and coaching capability.
  

* 

High ownership, integrity and attention to detail.

description:

**Department:** Manufacturing \& Sourcing  

  

**City:** Bangalore  

  

**State/Province:** Karnataka  

  

**Location:** India  

  

**Company Description**Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.
  

  

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.  

  

  

**Position Overview*** The Sr. Sourcing Specialist, Product Development – Home Bedding \& Bath supports owns the execution of the end\-to\-end sourcing and product development lifecycle for the Home Bedding \& Bath categories, ensuring alignment with Ralph Lauren standards, seasonal timelines, quality expectations, and business objectives.
* This role is responsible for supporting sample development, costing follow\-up, negotiation preparation, time and action plan management, vendor coordination, and production readiness to help secure orders and drive on\-time execution.
* The position partners closely with factories, vendors, and internal cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate development, proactive issue resolution, and clear communication throughout the sourcing process.
  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** **Responsibilities:**  

* Support the Sourcing Manager in executing category sourcing strategies for Home Bedding \& Bath, ensuring alignment with business needs, seasonal calendars, and Ralph Lauren standards.
* Manage the sample development process with factories and vendors to ensure samples are developed accurately, on time, and in accordance with design, quality, and product requirements.
* Coordinate costing activities, support price negotiations, and partner with the Sourcing Manager to identify opportunities that meet margin, quality, and aesthetic targets.
* Maintain and monitor time and action plans, ensuring key development, approval, pre\-production, and production milestones are tracked and completed on schedule.
* Work closely with factories to secure all production and operations\-related activities, including sample approvals, material readiness, testing, and pre\-production requirements.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams, including Product Development, Raw Materials, Quality, Merchandising, Production, and Supply Chain, to support smooth execution from development through delivery.
* Track vendor performance, escalate risks or delays, and help drive resolution to support on\-time delivery and business objectives.
* Maintain clear communication, accurate records, and timely updates for all development and production\-related activities.

  

**Experience, Skills, and Knowledge****Requirements:*** At least 10 years prior experience in sourcing, product development, or production within home textiles, bedding\& bath preferred.
* Strong understanding of the product development and sample approval process, with exposure to costing, vendor follow\-up, and production timelines.
* Knowledge of textile materials, fabric construction, finishing, testing, and quality expectations for Home Bedding \& Bath.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, calendars, and product categories in a structured process.
* Strong communication, follow\-up, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with internal teams, vendors, and factories.
* Comfortable working in Excel and related systems to track costing, development status, time and action plans, approvals, and reports.
* Adaptable, proactive, and able to work independently while escalating issues appropriately to the Sourcing Manager.
* Fluency in spoken and written English required.
